# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""Source-only FP8 paired-dot compilation; no GPU execution or IR override."""

import argparse
import ast
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import tarfile
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from tools import qsa_prefill_source_pipeline as compiler  # noqa: E402

trace = compiler.trace
NAME = "_qsa_prefill_fp8_store_score_kernel"
CASE = "fp8_tail113_float8_e4m3fn"
IR_SHA = "34341d3e47c9d09f788db6ea308c301a106d60dec25691bbb22c93b310f4bbbd"
OPTIONS_SHA = "1d535376c07db69eaf7a34f0dac9b7fd545ba227bfea5dbb0fa76e7ca2144f42"
PTX_SHA = "e1a00df3db738150cd2baeedacba5bf7cea8f6eb7c0a562023a2cb75921d55b8"
MOVE = "            scores_right = tl.dot(keys, query_right, out_dtype=tl.float32)\n"
ANCHOR = "            scores_left = tl.dot(keys, query_left, out_dtype=tl.float32)\n"
SOURCES = (
    "tools/qsa_prefill_fp8_dot_issue.py",
    "tools/test_qsa_prefill_fp8_dot_issue.py",
    "tools/run_qsa_prefill_fp8_dot_issue_h800.sh",
    "docs/qsa_prefill_fp8_dot_issue.md",
    *compiler.SOURCES,
)


def source(kind):
    path = ROOT / compiler.OP
    if trace.sha(path) != compiler.PRODUCTION_SHA:
        raise RuntimeError("Production source changed")
    text = path.read_text()
    functions = {
        n.name: ast.get_source_segment(text, n)
        for n in ast.parse(text).body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
    }
    kernel = functions[NAME] + "\n"
    if kernel.count(MOVE) != 1 or kernel.count(ANCHOR) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected FP8 split-query source")
    if kind == "paired":
        kernel = kernel.replace(MOVE, "").replace(ANCHOR, ANCHOR + MOVE)
    elif kind != "production":
        raise ValueError("Unknown source variant")
    return (
        "import triton\nimport triton.language as tl\n\n@triton.jit\n"
        + functions["_fp8_bulk_tail_store"]
        + '\n\n@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_rows", "query_offset", "max_query_len"])\n'
        + kernel
        + "\n_qsa_prefill_score_kernel = "
        + NAME
        + "\n"
    )


def abi(ir):
    names = next(
        n
        for n in ast.parse(source("production")).body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == NAME
    ).args.args
    names = [n.arg for n in names]
    header = next(
        line for line in ir.splitlines() if "tt.func public @" + NAME + "(" in line
    )
    found = list(re.finditer(r"%(\w+): (!tt.ptr<\w+>|i32)", header))
    signature, attrs = {}, {}
    for i, match in enumerate(found):
        name, typ = match.groups()
        if name not in names or name in signature:
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected captured ABI")
        element = typ[8:-1] if typ.startswith("!tt.ptr<") else typ
        types = {"f8E4M3FN": "fp8e4nv", "f32": "fp32", "i32": "i32"}
        if element not in types:
            raise RuntimeError("Unsupported captured type: " + element)
        signature[name] = ("*" if typ.startswith("!tt.ptr<") else "") + types[element]
        end = (
            found[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(found) else header.index(" attributes ")
        )
        attr = re.search(r"tt.divisibility = (\d+) : i32", header[match.end() : end])
        if attr:
            attrs[(names.index(name),)] = [("tt.divisibility", int(attr[1]))]
    constants = dict(
        stride_table_page=1,
        num_requests=1,
        PAGE_SIZE=196,
        NUM_HEADS=4,
        HEAD_DIM=128,
        IS_FP8=True,
        TILE_R=64,
        BLOCK_N=64,
        K_TILES=16,
        QUERY_PARTS=2,
    )
    if set(signature) != set(
        n for n in names[:19] if n not in ("stride_table_page", "num_requests")
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete runtime ABI")
    if signature["q_ptr"] != "*fp8e4nv" or signature["cache_ptr"] != "*fp8e4nv":
        raise RuntimeError("Expected original FP8 pointer types")
    signature.update({name: "constexpr" for name in constants})
    if set(signature) != set(names):
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete source signature")
    return signature, constants, attrs


def metrics(ir, ptx):
    clean = compiler.double.runtime.program(ptx)
    return dict(
        dot_epilogue_order=[
            line.strip()
            for line in ir.splitlines()
            if re.search(
                r"\b(?:ttng.warp_group_dot(?:_wait)?|tt.reduce|tt.store|ttg.convert_layout)\b",
                line,
            )
        ],
        dot_sites=len(re.findall(r"\bttng.warp_group_dot\b", ir)),
        dot_wait_sites=len(re.findall(r"\bttng.warp_group_dot_wait\b", ir)),
        mma_sites=len(re.findall(r"\bwgmma.mma_async\.", clean)),
        mma_wait_sites=len(re.findall(r"\bwgmma.wait_group\b", clean)),
        barriers=len(re.findall(r"\bbar.sync\b", clean)),
        async_copy_sites=len(
            re.findall(r"\bcp.async.(?:ca|cg).shared.global\b", clean)
        ),
    )


def gate(a, b):
    if b["spill_store_bytes"] or b["spill_load_bytes"]:
        return "candidate spills"
    if (
        b["registers_per_thread"] > a["registers_per_thread"]
        or b["shared_bytes"] > a["shared_bytes"]
    ):
        return "candidate resource usage increased"
    if any(
        a["instructions"][n] != b["instructions"][n] for n in ("dot_sites", "mma_sites")
    ):
        return "matrix work changed"
    if a["code_sha256"] == b["code_sha256"]:
        return "compiler emitted identical executable PTX"
    return None


def tile32_gate(original, sequential, paired):
    if paired["spill_store_bytes"] or paired["spill_load_bytes"]:
        return "candidate spills"
    if any(paired[k] > original[k] for k in ("registers_per_thread", "shared_bytes")):
        return "candidate exceeds original R64 resource ceiling"
    if any(
        sequential["instructions"][k] != paired["instructions"][k]
        for k in ("dot_sites", "mma_sites")
    ):
        return "same-tile matrix work changed"
    if (
        sequential["instructions"]["dot_sites"] != 2
        or sequential["instructions"]["mma_sites"] == 0
    ):
        return "unrecognized R32 matrix work"
    if paired["code_sha256"] == sequential["code_sha256"]:
        return "compiler emitted identical executable PTX"
    order = paired["instructions"]["dot_epilogue_order"]
    dots = [
        i for i, line in enumerate(order) if re.search(r"\bttng.warp_group_dot\b", line)
    ]
    waits = [i for i, line in enumerate(order) if "ttng.warp_group_dot_wait" in line]
    if (
        len(dots) != 2
        or len(waits) != 2
        or not (dots[0] < dots[1] < waits[0] < waits[1])
    ):
        return "paired issue not retained"
    pendings = [re.search(r"pendings = (\d+)", order[i]) for i in waits]
    if any(v is None for v in pendings) or [v.group(1) for v in pendings] != ["1", "0"]:
        return "unexpected paired wait protocol"
    return None


def prepare(previous, report, tile32=False):
    folder = previous / (CASE + "-replay")
    old = json.loads((folder / "spec.json").read_text())
    ir = folder / (NAME + ".ttir")
    metadata = folder / (NAME + ".json")
    ptx = folder / (NAME + ".ptx")
    if (trace.sha(ir), trace.sha(metadata), trace.sha(ptx)) != (
        IR_SHA,
        OPTIONS_SHA,
        PTX_SHA,
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Captured original input/options/PTX identity mismatch")
    if old["ir_sha256"] != IR_SHA or old["metadata_sha256"] != OPTIONS_SHA:
        raise RuntimeError("Captured provenance mismatch")
    options = json.loads(metadata.read_text())
    expected = dict(num_warps=4, num_stages=2, num_ctas=1)
    if any(options[k] != v for k, v in expected.items()):
        raise RuntimeError("Launch configuration changed")
    jobs = []
    for kind in (
        ("production", "sequential32", "paired32")
        if tile32
        else ("production", "paired")
    ):
        dest = report / kind
        dest.mkdir()
        module = dest / "kernel.py"
        module.write_text(
            source("paired" if kind.startswith("paired") else "production")
        )
        sig, fixed, attrs = abi(ir.read_text())
        if kind.endswith("32"):
            fixed["TILE_R"] = 32
        (dest / "options.json").write_bytes(metadata.read_bytes())
        job = dict(
            kind=kind,
            directory=str(dest),
            module=str(module),
            module_sha256=trace.sha(module),
            runtime=old["runtime"],
            metadata=str(dest / "options.json"),
            metadata_sha256=OPTIONS_SHA,
            signature=sig,
            constants=fixed,
            attrs=[[list(k), v] for k, v in attrs.items()],
            control_code_sha256=compiler.double.runtime.code_sha(ptx.read_text()),
        )
        trace.save(dest / "spec.json", job)
        jobs.append(job)
    return jobs


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--source-report", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--flagtree", default="/opt/flagtree")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=1800)
    parser.add_argument("--worker-spec")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--tile32",
        action="store_true",
        help="R64 source control plus R32 sequential/paired controls",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.worker_spec:
        return compiler.child(args)
    report = Path(args.report_dir).resolve()
    report.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    summary = dict(
        status="preparing",
        production_modified=False,
        gpu_kernel_executed=False,
        timings={},
        jobs=[],
    )
    try:
        trace.save(
            report / "sources.json",
            {
                n: dict(text=(ROOT / n).read_text(), sha256=trace.sha(ROOT / n))
                for n in dict.fromkeys(SOURCES)
            },
        )
        for job in prepare(Path(args.source_report).resolve(), report, args.tile32):
            dest = Path(job["directory"])
            code = trace.run_job(
                [
                    sys.executable,
                    "-I",
                    str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                    *sys.argv[1:],
                    "--worker-spec",
                    str(dest / "spec.json"),
                ],
                dict(os.environ, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="", PYTHONNOUSERSITE="1"),
                dest / "compiler.txt",
                args.timeout,
            )
            if code:
                print((dest / "compiler.txt").read_text()[-12000:], flush=True)
                raise RuntimeError("Source compile failed: " + job["kind"])
            result = json.loads((dest / "result.json").read_text())
            result.update(
                compiler.producer.resources((dest / "compiler.txt").read_text())
            )
            result["instructions"] = metrics(
                (dest / "ttgir.txt").read_text(), (dest / "ptx.txt").read_text()
            )
            trace.save(dest / "result.json", result)
            summary["jobs"].append(dict(kind=job["kind"], result=result))
            print(job["kind"], json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)
            if job["kind"] == "production":
                if (
                    result["code_sha256"] != job["control_code_sha256"]
                    or result["registers_per_thread"] != 158
                    or result["shared_bytes"] != 57344
                    or result["spill_store_bytes"]
                    or result["spill_load_bytes"]
                ):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "Source control did not reproduce original executable/resources"
                    )
            elif not args.tile32:
                reason = gate(summary["jobs"][0]["result"], result)
                summary.update(
                    status=(
                        "not_promising" if reason else "pending_lifetime_and_accuracy"
                    ),
                    reason=reason,
                )
                print("Decision:", summary["status"], "reason:", reason, flush=True)
        if args.tile32:
            original, sequential, paired = [j["result"] for j in summary["jobs"]]
            reason = tile32_gate(original, sequential, paired)
            summary.update(
                status="not_promising" if reason else "pending_lifetime_and_accuracy",
                reason=reason,
                tile32=True,
                resource_delta_vs_sequential={
                    k: paired[k] - sequential[k]
                    for k in ("registers_per_thread", "shared_bytes")
                },
            )
            print(
                "R32 paired minus sequential resources:",
                summary["resource_delta_vs_sequential"],
                flush=True,
            )
            print("Decision:", summary["status"], "reason:", reason, flush=True)
        return 0
    except Exception:
        summary.update(status="failed", error=traceback.format_exc())
        print(summary["error"], flush=True)
        return 1
    finally:
        trace.save(report / "fp8-dot-issue-summary.json", summary)
        with tarfile.open(report / "fp8-dot-issue-artifacts.tar.gz", "w:gz") as archive:
            for kind in ("production", "paired", "sequential32", "paired32"):
                folder = report / kind
                if folder.is_dir():
                    for path in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
                        if path.is_file():
                            archive.add(
                                path,
                                arcname=str(path.relative_to(report)),
                                recursive=False,
                            )
        print("Compile report:", report, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""Source-only FP8 movement, actual ABI type names and conservative gates."""

import ast
import copy
import unittest

from tools import qsa_prefill_fp8_dot_issue as p


class DotIssueTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_move_preserves_every_ast_node_except_statement_order(self):
        a, b = p.source("production"), p.source("paired")
        self.assertEqual(
            b.replace(p.ANCHOR + p.MOVE, p.ANCHOR).replace(
                "            scores_right = tl.reshape",
                p.MOVE + "            scores_right = tl.reshape",
                1,
            ),
            a,
        )
        trees = [ast.parse(s) for s in (a, b)]
        for tree in trees:
            fn = next(
                n
                for n in tree.body
                if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == p.NAME
            )
            loop = next(n for n in fn.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
            branch = next(
                n
                for n in loop.body
                if isinstance(n, ast.If)
                and isinstance(n.test, ast.Name)
                and n.test.id == "SPLIT_QUERY"
            )
            right = next(
                n
                for n in branch.body
                if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)
                and n.targets[0].id == "scores_right"
                and isinstance(n.value, ast.Call)
                and isinstance(n.value.func, ast.Attribute)
                and n.value.func.attr == "dot"
            )
            branch.body.remove(right)
            branch.body.insert(1, right)
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(trees[0]), ast.dump(trees[1]))
        self.assertEqual(a.count("tl.dot("), b.count("tl.dot("))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            p.source("unknown")

    def header(self):
        fn = next(
            n
            for n in ast.parse(p.source("production")).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == p.NAME
        )
        return (
            "tt.func public @"
            + p.NAME
            + "("
            + ", ".join(
                "%"
                + n.arg
                + ": "
                + (
                    "!tt.ptr<f8E4M3FN>"
                    if i < 2
                    else (
                        "!tt.ptr<i32>" if i < 5 else "!tt.ptr<f32>" if i == 5 else "i32"
                    )
                )
                + " {tt.divisibility = 16 : i32} loc(unknown)"
                for i, n in enumerate(fn.args.args[:19])
                if n.arg not in ("stride_table_page", "num_requests")
            )
            + ") attributes {noinline=false} {"
        )

    def test_astsource_uses_triton_type_names_not_mlir_type_names(self):
        sig, constants, attrs = p.abi(self.header())
        self.assertEqual(sig["q_ptr"], "*fp8e4nv")
        self.assertEqual(sig["cache_ptr"], "*fp8e4nv")
        self.assertEqual(sig["logits_ptr"], "*fp32")
        self.assertEqual(sig["num_rows"], "i32")
        self.assertEqual(len(sig), 27)
        self.assertEqual(constants["QUERY_PARTS"], 2)
        self.assertTrue(constants["IS_FP8"])
        self.assertEqual(attrs[(0,)], [("tt.divisibility", 16)])
        for header in (
            self.header().replace("f8E4M3FN", "bf16"),
            self.header().replace("%num_rows:", "%unexpected:"),
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                p.abi(header)

    def test_gate_rejects_unchanged_code_spills_resources_or_work(self):
        a = dict(
            code_sha256="a",
            registers_per_thread=158,
            shared_bytes=57344,
            spill_store_bytes=0,
            spill_load_bytes=0,
            instructions=dict(dot_sites=2, mma_sites=8),
        )
        b = dict(a, code_sha256="b")
        self.assertIsNone(p.gate(a, b))
        self.assertIsNotNone(p.gate(a, a))
        for name, value in (
            ("spill_store_bytes", 8),
            ("spill_load_bytes", 8),
            ("registers_per_thread", 159),
            ("shared_bytes", 65536),
        ):
            self.assertIsNotNone(p.gate(a, dict(b, **{name: value})))
        c = copy.deepcopy(b)
        c["instructions"]["mma_sites"] = 4
        self.assertIsNotNone(p.gate(a, c))

    def test_tile32_accepts_overlap_cost_only_under_original_ceiling(self):
        original = dict(registers_per_thread=158, shared_bytes=57344)
        sequential = dict(
            code_sha256="sequential",
            registers_per_thread=90,
            shared_bytes=32768,
            spill_store_bytes=0,
            spill_load_bytes=0,
            instructions=dict(dot_sites=2, mma_sites=8),
        )
        order = [
            "%a = ttng.warp_group_dot",
            "%b = ttng.warp_group_dot",
            "%l = ttng.warp_group_dot_wait {pendings = 1 : i32}",
            "tt.reduce",
            "tt.store",
            "%r = ttng.warp_group_dot_wait {pendings = 0 : i32}",
        ]
        paired = dict(
            sequential,
            code_sha256="paired",
            registers_per_thread=120,
            instructions=dict(dot_sites=2, mma_sites=8, dot_epilogue_order=order),
        )
        self.assertIsNone(p.tile32_gate(original, sequential, paired))
        for key, value in (
            ("registers_per_thread", 159),
            ("shared_bytes", 65536),
            ("spill_load_bytes", 4),
            ("code_sha256", "sequential"),
        ):
            self.assertIsNotNone(
                p.tile32_gate(original, sequential, dict(paired, **{key: value}))
            )
        for changed in (
            [line.replace("pendings = 1", "pendings = 0") for line in order],
            [order[0], order[2], order[1], *order[3:]],
            [line.replace("pendings = 1", "unknown = 1") for line in order],
        ):
            bad = dict(
                paired,
                instructions=dict(paired["instructions"], dot_epilogue_order=changed),
            )
            self.assertIsNotNone(p.tile32_gate(original, sequential, bad))
        bad = dict(paired, instructions=dict(paired["instructions"], mma_sites=4))
        self.assertIsNotNone(p.tile32_gate(original, sequential, bad))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

  echo "重试：git -C '$qsa_tree' push https://github.com/cheersluvs/FlagGems-vllm.git 'HEAD:refs/heads/$qsa_branch'"

# FP8 source-level paired dot issue probe

## Scope board

| Item | Decision |
| --- | --- |
| Hypothesis | Issue the independent right-query full-D dot immediately after the left dot, before the left epilogue; inspect whether waits/layout transitions change |
| Editable | New diagnostic source generator, offline compile driver, tests and runner |
| Read-only | Production source SHA256 0d7e80e240966565a7c78151c8344f17e0627e73920f5229aadcc0f0fb42f10e, compiler, assembler, launch options, masks, TopK and tolerances |
| Excluded | Producer-first IR overrides, compiler patches, manual barriers, FP8 buffer edits and BF16 candidates |

## Implementation board

| Item | Decision |

"""BF16/FP8 QSA paged prefill selection for NVIDIA SM90.

API/semantics reference: vllm-project/vllm, commit
7a877ae34dcf4a7d46de08eb16db4699e1e0047c,
vllm/models/qwen4_exp/nvidia/ops/qsa_indexer.py.

Rectangular scoring uses keys x query with dtype-specific tuned configurations.
Aligned FP8 logits use vector bulk writes followed by a masked scalar tail.
Low-utilization ragged batches use compact request-local query tiles.
Top-K is provided by this repository, without a vLLM extension dependency.
Selection order and tie-breaking are unspecified. Device-resident metadata
must satisfy the documented value preconditions; validation does not copy it
to the host. Autograd is not supported.
"""

import os

import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl

from flaggems_vllm import runtime
from flaggems_vllm.ops.persistent_topk import persistent_topk
from flaggems_vllm.utils import libentry, libtuner
from flaggems_vllm.utils.libentry import LibEntry


class _QSAScoreEntry(LibEntry):
    """Keep the outer runtime cache consistent with the existing score tuner."""

    def key(self, spec_args, dns_args, const_args):
        named = {
            self.arg_names[index]: value
            for index, value in zip(self.specialize_indices, spec_args)
        }
        named.update(
            (self.arg_names[index], value)
            for index, value in zip(self.do_not_specialize_indices, dns_args)
        )
        constexpr_names = (
            param.name for param in self.jit_function.params if param.is_constexpr
        )
        named.update(zip(constexpr_names, const_args))
        return super().key(spec_args, dns_args, const_args) + (self.fn.get_key(named),)


def _prune_head_group_configs(configs, named_args, **kwargs):
    args = {**named_args, **kwargs}
    eligible = not args["IS_FP8"] and args["NUM_HEADS"] == 4 and args["HEAD_DIM"] == 128
    return [
        c
        for c in configs
        if not c.kwargs["HEAD_GROUP"]
        or (eligible and c.kwargs["TILE_R"] == 64 and c.num_warps == 4)
    ]


def _prune_fp8_store_configs(configs, named_args, **kwargs):
    args = {**named_args, **kwargs}
    return [
        c
        for c in configs
        if c.kwargs["QUERY_PARTS"] == 1
        or (
            args["IS_FP8"] and c.kwargs["QUERY_PARTS"] == 2 and c.kwargs["TILE_R"] >= 32
        )
    ]


@triton.jit
def _fp8_bulk_tail_store(ptrs, values, valid_rows, columns, visible, logits_width):
    limit = tl.minimum(visible, logits_width)
    full = tl.multiple_of(limit // 4 * 4, (4, 4))
    tl.store(ptrs, values, mask=valid_rows & (columns < full))
    tl.store(ptrs, values, mask=valid_rows & (columns >= full) & (columns < limit))


@_QSAScoreEntry
@libtuner(
    configs=runtime.get_tuned_config("qsa_select_paged_prefill_fp8_store_score"),
    key=[
        "num_rows",
        "max_query_len",
        "logits_width",
        "num_requests",
        "PAGE_SIZE",
        "NUM_HEADS",
        "HEAD_DIM",
        "IS_FP8",
        "stride_q_row",
        "stride_q_head",
        "stride_cache_block",
        "stride_cache_token",
        "stride_table_req",
        "stride_table_page",
    ],
    strategy="default",
    prune_configs_by={"early_config_prune": _prune_fp8_store_configs},
)
@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_rows", "query_offset", "max_query_len"])
def _qsa_prefill_fp8_store_score_kernel(
    q_ptr,
    cache_ptr,
    table_ptr,
    starts_ptr,
    visible_ptr,
    logits_ptr,
    stride_q_row,
    stride_q_head,
    stride_cache_block,
    stride_cache_token,
    stride_table_req,
    stride_table_page,
    num_rows,
    query_offset,
    max_query_len,
    logits_width,
    num_requests,
    num_pages,
    table_width,
    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
    NUM_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
    IS_FP8: tl.constexpr,
    TILE_R: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
    K_TILES: tl.constexpr,
    QUERY_PARTS: tl.constexpr,
):
    request = tl.program_id(0)
    query_base = tl.load(starts_ptr)
    request_start = tl.maximum(tl.load(starts_ptr + request) - query_base, query_offset)
    request_end = tl.minimum(
        tl.load(starts_ptr + request + 1) - query_base, query_offset + num_rows
    )
    row_start = request_start + tl.program_id(1) * TILE_R
    if row_start >= request_end:
        return

    HEADS_PADDED: tl.constexpr = triton.next_power_of_2(NUM_HEADS)
    # tl.dot requires N>=16 even when TILE_R * HEADS_PADDED is smaller.
    # Fake rows do not read queries/metadata or write outside this query tile.
    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr = max(TILE_R, triton.cdiv(16, HEADS_PADDED))
    SPLIT_QUERY: tl.constexpr = IS_FP8 and TILE_R >= 32 and QUERY_PARTS == 2
    row_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
    rows = row_start + row_lanes
    valid_rows = (row_lanes < TILE_R) & (rows < request_end)
    visible = tl.load(visible_ptr + rows, mask=valid_rows, other=0)
    max_visible = tl.minimum(tl.max(visible, axis=0), logits_width)
    first_tile = tl.program_id(2) * K_TILES
    if first_tile * BLOCK_N >= max_visible:
        return
    last_tile = tl.minimum(first_tile + K_TILES, tl.cdiv(max_visible, BLOCK_N))

    # Padded heads are adjacent in the dot result. Mask them before reduction.
    query_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R * HEADS_PADDED)
    query_row_lanes = query_lanes // HEADS_PADDED
    query_rows = row_start + query_row_lanes
    heads = query_lanes % HEADS_PADDED
    # Pad the reduction dimension to the native dot instruction's minimum.
    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr = max(32 if IS_FP8 else 16, triton.next_power_of_2(HEAD_DIM))
    dims = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
    if SPLIT_QUERY:
        HALF_R: tl.constexpr = TILE_R // 2
        half_lanes = tl.arange(0, HALF_R * HEADS_PADDED)
        half_rows = half_lanes // HEADS_PADDED
        half_heads = half_lanes % HEADS_PADDED
        query_left = tl.load(
            q_ptr
            + (row_start + 0 + half_rows)[None, :] * stride_q_row
            + half_heads[None, :] * stride_q_head
            + dims[:, None],
            mask=((row_start + 0 + half_rows)[None, :] < request_end)
            & (half_heads[None, :] < NUM_HEADS)
            & (dims[:, None] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
        query_right = tl.load(
            q_ptr
            + (row_start + HALF_R + half_rows)[None, :] * stride_q_row
            + half_heads[None, :] * stride_q_head
            + dims[:, None],
            mask=((row_start + HALF_R + half_rows)[None, :] < request_end)
            & (half_heads[None, :] < NUM_HEADS)
            & (dims[:, None] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
        visible_left, visible_right = tl.split(
            tl.trans(tl.reshape(visible, (2, HALF_R)))
        )
    else:
        query = tl.load(
            q_ptr
            + query_rows[None, :] * stride_q_row
            + heads[None, :] * stride_q_head
            + dims[:, None],
            mask=(query_row_lanes[None, :] < TILE_R)
            & (query_rows[None, :] < request_end)
            & (heads[None, :] < NUM_HEADS)
            & (dims[:, None] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
    column_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
    for tile in range(first_tile, last_tile):
        columns = tile * BLOCK_N + column_lanes
        logical_page = columns // PAGE_SIZE
        page_offset = columns % PAGE_SIZE
        live = (columns < max_visible) & (logical_page < table_width)
        if not IS_FP8 and BLOCK_N <= PAGE_SIZE:
            first_page = tile * BLOCK_N // PAGE_SIZE
            second_page = first_page + 1
            first_id = tl.load(
                table_ptr + request * stride_table_req + first_page * stride_table_page,
                mask=(tile * BLOCK_N < max_visible) & (first_page < table_width),
                other=0,
            )
            second_id = tl.load(
                table_ptr
                + request * stride_table_req
                + second_page * stride_table_page,
                mask=(second_page < table_width)
                & (
                    second_page * PAGE_SIZE
                    < tl.minimum((tile + 1) * BLOCK_N, max_visible)
                ),
                other=0,
            )
            physical_page = tl.where(logical_page == first_page, first_id, second_id)
        else:
            physical_page = tl.load(
                table_ptr
                + request * stride_table_req
                + logical_page * stride_table_page,
                mask=live,
                other=0,
            )
        live &= (physical_page >= 0) & (physical_page < num_pages)
        keys = tl.load(
            cache_ptr
            + physical_page[:, None].to(tl.int64) * stride_cache_block
            + page_offset[:, None] * stride_cache_token
            + dims[None, :],
            mask=live[:, None] & (dims[None, :] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
        if SPLIT_QUERY:
            scores_left = tl.dot(keys, query_left, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            scores_left = tl.reshape(scores_left, (BLOCK_N, HALF_R, HEADS_PADDED))
            real_heads_left = tl.arange(0, HEADS_PADDED) < NUM_HEADS
            scores_left = tl.where(
                real_heads_left[None, None, :], tl.maximum(scores_left, 0.0), 0.0
            )
            scores_left = tl.sum(scores_left, axis=2)
            rows_left = row_start + 0 + tl.arange(0, HALF_R)
            _fp8_bulk_tail_store(
                logits_ptr
                + (rows_left - query_offset)[None, :] * logits_width
                + columns[:, None],
                tl.where(live[:, None], scores_left, -float("inf")),
                valid_rows=(rows_left[None, :] < request_end),
                columns=columns[:, None],
                visible=visible_left[None, :],
                logits_width=logits_width,
            )
            scores_right = tl.dot(keys, query_right, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            scores_right = tl.reshape(scores_right, (BLOCK_N, HALF_R, HEADS_PADDED))
            real_heads_right = tl.arange(0, HEADS_PADDED) < NUM_HEADS
            scores_right = tl.where(
                real_heads_right[None, None, :], tl.maximum(scores_right, 0.0), 0.0
            )
            scores_right = tl.sum(scores_right, axis=2)
            rows_right = row_start + HALF_R + tl.arange(0, HALF_R)
            _fp8_bulk_tail_store(
                logits_ptr
                + (rows_right - query_offset)[None, :] * logits_width
                + columns[:, None],
                tl.where(live[:, None], scores_right, -float("inf")),
                valid_rows=(rows_right[None, :] < request_end),
                columns=columns[:, None],
                visible=visible_right[None, :],
                logits_width=logits_width,
            )
        else:
            scores = tl.dot(keys, query, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            scores = tl.reshape(scores, (BLOCK_N, BLOCK_R, HEADS_PADDED))
            real_heads = tl.arange(0, HEADS_PADDED) < NUM_HEADS
            scores = tl.where(real_heads[None, None, :], tl.maximum(scores, 0.0), 0.0)
            scores = tl.sum(scores, axis=2)
            _fp8_bulk_tail_store(
                logits_ptr
                + (rows - query_offset)[None, :] * logits_width
                + columns[:, None],
                tl.where(live[:, None], scores, -float("inf")),
                valid_rows=valid_rows[None, :],
                columns=columns[:, None],
                visible=visible[None, :],
                logits_width=logits_width,
            )


# Fixed-size bandwidth-only fills: no autotune. They do not perform selection.
@triton.jit
def _select_all_kernel(visible_ptr, output_ptr, K: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    row = tl.program_id(0)
    columns = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
    visible = tl.load(visible_ptr + row)
    tl.store(
        output_ptr + row * K + columns,
        tl.where(columns < visible, columns, -1),
        mask=columns < K,
    )


@_QSAScoreEntry
@libtuner(
    configs=runtime.get_tuned_config("qsa_select_paged_prefill_head_group_score"),
    key=[
        "num_rows",
        "max_query_len",
        "logits_width",
        "num_requests",
        "PAGE_SIZE",
        "NUM_HEADS",
        "HEAD_DIM",
        "IS_FP8",
        "stride_q_row",
        "stride_q_head",
        "stride_cache_block",
        "stride_cache_token",
        "stride_table_req",
        "stride_table_page",
    ],
    strategy="default",
    prune_configs_by={"early_config_prune": _prune_head_group_configs},
)
@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_rows", "query_offset", "max_query_len"])
def _qsa_prefill_score_kernel(
    q_ptr,
    cache_ptr,
    table_ptr,
    starts_ptr,
    visible_ptr,
    logits_ptr,
    stride_q_row,
    stride_q_head,
    stride_cache_block,
    stride_cache_token,
    stride_table_req,
    stride_table_page,
    num_rows,
    query_offset,
    max_query_len,
    logits_width,
    num_requests,
    num_pages,
    table_width,
    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
    NUM_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
    IS_FP8: tl.constexpr,
    TILE_R: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
    K_TILES: tl.constexpr,
    HEAD_GROUP: tl.constexpr = False,
):
    request = tl.program_id(0)
    query_base = tl.load(starts_ptr)
    request_start = tl.maximum(tl.load(starts_ptr + request) - query_base, query_offset)
    request_end = tl.minimum(
        tl.load(starts_ptr + request + 1) - query_base, query_offset + num_rows
    )
    row_start = request_start + tl.program_id(1) * TILE_R
    if row_start >= request_end:
        return

    GROUP_HEADS: tl.constexpr = (
        HEAD_GROUP
        and not IS_FP8
        and NUM_HEADS == 4
        and HEAD_DIM == 128
        and TILE_R == 64
    )
    HEADS_PADDED: tl.constexpr = 2 if GROUP_HEADS else triton.next_power_of_2(NUM_HEADS)
    # tl.dot requires N>=16 even when TILE_R * HEADS_PADDED is smaller.
    # Fake rows do not read queries/metadata or write outside this query tile.
    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr = max(TILE_R, triton.cdiv(16, HEADS_PADDED))
    row_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
    rows = row_start + row_lanes
    valid_rows = (row_lanes < TILE_R) & (rows < request_end)
    visible = tl.load(visible_ptr + rows, mask=valid_rows, other=0)
    max_visible = tl.minimum(tl.max(visible, axis=0), logits_width)
    first_tile = tl.program_id(2) * K_TILES
    if first_tile * BLOCK_N >= max_visible:
        return
    last_tile = tl.minimum(first_tile + K_TILES, tl.cdiv(max_visible, BLOCK_N))

    # Padded heads are adjacent in the dot result. Mask them before reduction.
    query_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R * HEADS_PADDED)
    query_row_lanes = query_lanes // HEADS_PADDED
    query_rows = row_start + query_row_lanes
    heads = query_lanes % HEADS_PADDED
    # Pad the reduction dimension to the native dot instruction's minimum.
    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr = max(32 if IS_FP8 else 16, triton.next_power_of_2(HEAD_DIM))
    dims = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
    query = tl.load(
        q_ptr
        + query_rows[None, :] * stride_q_row
        + heads[None, :] * stride_q_head
        + dims[:, None],
        mask=(query_row_lanes[None, :] < TILE_R)
        & (query_rows[None, :] < request_end)
        & (heads[None, :] < NUM_HEADS)
        & (dims[:, None] < HEAD_DIM),
        other=0.0,
    )
    if GROUP_HEADS:
        query_high = tl.load(
            q_ptr
            + query_rows[None, :] * stride_q_row
            + (heads[None, :] + 2) * stride_q_head
            + dims[:, None],
            mask=(query_row_lanes[None, :] < TILE_R)
            & (query_rows[None, :] < request_end)
            & (heads[None, :] < NUM_HEADS)
            & (dims[:, None] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
    column_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
    for tile in range(first_tile, last_tile):
        columns = tile * BLOCK_N + column_lanes
        logical_page = columns // PAGE_SIZE
        page_offset = columns % PAGE_SIZE
        live = (columns < max_visible) & (logical_page < table_width)
        physical_page = tl.load(
            table_ptr + request * stride_table_req + logical_page * stride_table_page,
            mask=live,
            other=0,
        )
        live &= (physical_page >= 0) & (physical_page < num_pages)
        keys = tl.load(
            cache_ptr
            + physical_page[:, None].to(tl.int64) * stride_cache_block
            + page_offset[:, None] * stride_cache_token
            + dims[None, :],
            mask=live[:, None] & (dims[None, :] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
        if GROUP_HEADS:
            low = tl.dot(keys, query, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            low = tl.sum(
                tl.maximum(tl.reshape(low, (BLOCK_N, BLOCK_R, 2)), 0.0), axis=2
            )
            high = tl.dot(keys, query_high, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            high = tl.sum(
                tl.maximum(tl.reshape(high, (BLOCK_N, BLOCK_R, 2)), 0.0), axis=2
            )
            scores = low + high
        else:
            scores = tl.dot(keys, query, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            scores = tl.reshape(scores, (BLOCK_N, BLOCK_R, HEADS_PADDED))
            real_heads = tl.arange(0, HEADS_PADDED) < NUM_HEADS
            scores = tl.where(real_heads[None, None, :], tl.maximum(scores, 0.0), 0.0)
            scores = tl.sum(scores, axis=2)
        tl.store(
            logits_ptr
            + (rows - query_offset)[None, :] * logits_width
            + columns[:, None],
            tl.where(live[:, None], scores, -float("inf")),
            mask=valid_rows[None, :]
            & (columns[:, None] < visible[None, :])
            & (columns[:, None] < logits_width),
        )


@libentry()
@libtuner(
    configs=runtime.get_tuned_config("qsa_select_paged_prefill_score"),
    key=[

        "max_query_len",
        "logits_width",
        "num_requests",
        "PAGE_SIZE",
        "NUM_HEADS",
        "HEAD_DIM",
        "IS_FP8",
        "stride_q_row",
        "stride_q_head",
        "stride_cache_block",
        "stride_cache_token",
        "stride_table_req",
        "stride_table_page",
    ],
    strategy="default",
)
@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_rows", "query_offset", "max_query_len"])
def _qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel(
    q_ptr,
    cache_ptr,
    table_ptr,
    starts_ptr,
    visible_ptr,
    logits_ptr,
    stride_q_row,
    stride_q_head,
    stride_cache_block,
    stride_cache_token,
    stride_table_req,
    stride_table_page,
    num_rows,
    query_offset,
    max_query_len,
    logits_width,
    num_requests,
    num_pages,
    table_width,
    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
    NUM_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
    IS_FP8: tl.constexpr,
    TILE_R: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
    K_TILES: tl.constexpr,
):
    # Monotone slot boundaries include one padding slot per request. This
    # avoids the rectangular requests * max_query_len grid without a prefix
    # scan, host metadata reads, atomics or an extra launch/workspace.
    slot = tl.program_id(0)
    query_base = tl.load(starts_ptr)
    low, high = 0, num_requests
    while low + 1 < high:
        middle = (low + high) // 2
        start = tl.load(starts_ptr + middle) - query_base - query_offset
        start = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(start, 0), num_rows)
        boundary = start // TILE_R + middle
        if boundary <= slot:
            low = middle
        else:
            high = middle
    request = low
    start = tl.load(starts_ptr + request) - query_base - query_offset
    clipped_start = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(start, 0), num_rows)
    first_slot = clipped_start // TILE_R + request
    request_start = query_offset + clipped_start
    request_end = tl.minimum(
        tl.load(starts_ptr + request + 1) - query_base, query_offset + num_rows
    )
    row_start = request_start + (slot - first_slot) * TILE_R
    if row_start >= request_end:
        return

    HEADS_PADDED: tl.constexpr = triton.next_power_of_2(NUM_HEADS)
    # tl.dot requires M>=16 even when TILE_R * HEADS_PADDED is smaller.
    # Fake rows do not read queries/metadata or write outside this query tile.
    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr = max(TILE_R, triton.cdiv(16, HEADS_PADDED))
    row_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
    rows = row_start + row_lanes
    valid_rows = (row_lanes < TILE_R) & (rows < request_end)
    visible = tl.load(visible_ptr + rows, mask=valid_rows, other=0)
    max_visible = tl.minimum(tl.max(visible, axis=0), logits_width)
    first_tile = tl.program_id(2) * K_TILES
    if first_tile * BLOCK_N >= max_visible:
        return
    last_tile = tl.minimum(first_tile + K_TILES, tl.cdiv(max_visible, BLOCK_N))

    # Padded heads are adjacent in the dot result. Mask them before reduction.
    query_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R * HEADS_PADDED)
    query_row_lanes = query_lanes // HEADS_PADDED
    query_rows = row_start + query_row_lanes
    heads = query_lanes % HEADS_PADDED
    # Pad the reduction dimension to the native dot instruction's minimum.
    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr = max(32 if IS_FP8 else 16, triton.next_power_of_2(HEAD_DIM))
    dims = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
    query = tl.load(
        q_ptr
        + query_rows[:, None] * stride_q_row
        + heads[:, None] * stride_q_head
        + dims[None, :],
        mask=(query_row_lanes[:, None] < TILE_R)
        & (query_rows[:, None] < request_end)
        & (heads[:, None] < NUM_HEADS)
        & (dims[None, :] < HEAD_DIM),
        other=0.0,
    )
    column_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
    for tile in range(first_tile, last_tile):
        columns = tile * BLOCK_N + column_lanes
        logical_page = columns // PAGE_SIZE
        page_offset = columns % PAGE_SIZE
        live = (columns < max_visible) & (logical_page < table_width)
        physical_page = tl.load(
            table_ptr + request * stride_table_req + logical_page * stride_table_page,
            mask=live,
            other=0,
        )
        live &= (physical_page >= 0) & (physical_page < num_pages)
        keys = tl.load(
            cache_ptr
            + physical_page[None, :].to(tl.int64) * stride_cache_block
            + page_offset[None, :] * stride_cache_token
            + dims[:, None],
            mask=live[None, :] & (dims[:, None] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
        scores = tl.dot(query, keys, out_dtype=tl.float32)
        scores = tl.reshape(scores, (BLOCK_R, HEADS_PADDED, BLOCK_N))
        real_heads = tl.arange(0, HEADS_PADDED) < NUM_HEADS
        scores = tl.where(real_heads[None, :, None], tl.maximum(scores, 0.0), 0.0)
        scores = tl.sum(scores, axis=1)
        tl.store(
            logits_ptr
            + (rows - query_offset)[:, None] * logits_width
            + columns[None, :],
            tl.where(live[None, :], scores, -float("inf")),
            mask=valid_rows[:, None]
            & (columns[None, :] < visible[:, None])
            & (columns[None, :] < logits_width),
        )


def _compact_eligible(total_rows, requests, max_query_len, chunk_rows):
    # Capacity (before TILE_R rounding) must be at least 4x the actual rows.
    # This excludes the measured two-request regressions without a shape list.
    return (
        requests > 1
        and total_rows < requests * max_query_len
        and chunk_rows > max_query_len
        and requests * max_query_len >= 4 * chunk_rows
    )


def _check_nonoverlapping_strides(tensor, name):
    # Empty tensors may report contiguous even when the conservative stride
    # rule below rejects their layout. Keep that existing error behavior.
    if tensor.is_contiguous() and tensor.numel():
        return
    extent = 1
    for stride, size in sorted(zip(tensor.stride(), tensor.shape)):
        if size > 1:
            if stride < extent:
                raise NotImplementedError(f"{name} must have nonoverlapping strides")
            extent += (size - 1) * stride


def _output_overlaps_inputs(output, inputs):
    """Check conservative byte hulls after output contiguity validation.

    Bounds are local to this call: no tensor/storage metadata is cached across
    invocations. Padding holes in a strided input remain part of its hull.
    """
    count = output.numel()
    if not count:
        return False
    output_start = output.data_ptr()
    output_end = output_start + count * output.element_size()
    for tensor in inputs:
        count = tensor.numel()
        if not count:
            continue
        start = tensor.data_ptr()
        if start >= output_end:
            continue
        if not tensor.is_contiguous():
            count = 1 + sum(
                (size - 1) * stride
                for size, stride in zip(tensor.shape, tensor.stride())
            )
        if output_start < start + count * tensor.element_size():
            return True
    return False


def _validate_inputs(
    q,
    k_cache,
    page_table,
    query_start_loc,
    visible_blocks,
    token_topk,
    compress_ratio,
    max_query_len,
    block_indices,
    max_seq_len,
):
    tensors = (q, k_cache, page_table, query_start_loc, visible_blocks, block_indices)
    if q.device.type != "cuda" or runtime.device.vendor_name != "nvidia":
        raise NotImplementedError("QSA prefill currently requires NVIDIA CUDA SM90")
    if any(t.device != q.device for t in tensors):
        raise ValueError("QSA prefill tensors must be on the same device")
    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability(q.device) != (9, 0):
        raise NotImplementedError("QSA prefill currently supports SM90 (H800/H100)")
    if q.dtype != k_cache.dtype:
        raise ValueError("Q and the compressed K cache must match dtype")
    if q.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn):
        raise NotImplementedError("QSA prefill supports BF16/FP8 E4M3FN query/cache")
    if q.ndim != 3:
        raise NotImplementedError("QSA prefill query must be [tokens, heads, head_dim]")
    if q.shape[1] <= 0 or q.shape[2] <= 0:
        raise ValueError("QSA prefill heads and head_dim must be positive")
    if k_cache.ndim != 4 or k_cache.shape[2:] != (1, q.shape[2]):
        raise NotImplementedError(
            "QSA prefill cache must be [pages, page_size, 1, D] matching Q"
        )
    if q.requires_grad or k_cache.requires_grad:
        raise NotImplementedError("QSA prefill is inference-only")
    for name, value in (
        ("token_topk", token_topk),
        ("compress_ratio", compress_ratio),
        ("max_query_len", max_query_len),
        ("max_seq_len", max_seq_len),
    ):
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
            raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an integer")
    if compress_ratio <= 0 or token_topk <= 0 or token_topk % compress_ratio:
        raise ValueError("token_topk must be positive and divisible by compress_ratio")
    k = token_topk // compress_ratio
    if k not in (512, 1024, 2048):
        raise NotImplementedError("QSA prefill supports block Top-K 512/1024/2048")
    rows = q.shape[0]
    if page_table.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("page_table must be [requests, max_pages]")
    if page_table.dtype not in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
        raise TypeError("page_table must use int32/int64")
    if query_start_loc.shape != (page_table.shape[0] + 1,):
        raise ValueError("query_start_loc must contain requests + 1 offsets")
    if query_start_loc.dtype not in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
        raise TypeError("query_start_loc must use int32/int64")
    if visible_blocks.shape != (rows,) or visible_blocks.dtype != torch.int32:
        raise ValueError("visible_blocks must be int32 [tokens]")
    if block_indices.shape != (rows, k) or block_indices.dtype != torch.int32:
        raise ValueError("block_indices must be int32 [tokens, block_topk]")
    if max_query_len < 0 or max_seq_len < 0:
        raise ValueError("maximum lengths must be nonnegative")
    if rows and (
        not all(k_cache.shape[:2])
        or not all(page_table.shape)
        or max_query_len == 0
        or max_seq_len == 0
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "nonempty queries require positive cache/table/maximum lengths"
        )
    if q.stride(-1) != 1 or k_cache.stride(-1) != 1:
        raise NotImplementedError("QSA query/cache require unit innermost stride")
    for name, tensor in (("q", q), ("cache", k_cache), ("page_table", page_table)):
        _check_nonoverlapping_strides(tensor, name)
    for tensor in (query_start_loc, visible_blocks, block_indices):
        if not tensor.is_contiguous():
            raise NotImplementedError("QSA metadata/output must be contiguous")
    if _output_overlaps_inputs(block_indices, tensors[:-1]):
        raise ValueError("block_indices must not overlap any input")
    return rows, k


def _prefill_score_metadata(q, k_cache, page_table):
    """Scalar launch parameters, scoped to one validated public call."""
    return (
        (
            q.stride(0),
            q.stride(1),
            k_cache.stride(0),
            k_cache.stride(1),
            page_table.stride(0),
            page_table.stride(1),
        ),
        (page_table.shape[0], k_cache.shape[0], page_table.shape[1]),
        dict(
            PAGE_SIZE=k_cache.shape[1],
            NUM_HEADS=q.shape[1],
            HEAD_DIM=q.shape[2],
            IS_FP8=q.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn,
        ),
    )


def _fp8_store_eligible(q, logits, logits_width):
    return (
        q.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
        and logits.dtype == torch.float32
        and logits.is_contiguous()
        and logits.ndim == 2
        and logits.shape[1] == logits_width
        and logits_width > 0
        and logits_width % 4 == 0
        and logits.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
    )


def _prefill_logits(
    q,
    k_cache,
    page_table,
    query_start_loc,
    visible_blocks,
    logits_workspace,
    max_query_len,
    logits_width,
    query_offset,
    num_queries,
    *,
    launch_metadata=None,
):
    """Internal score launcher; inputs have already passed host validation."""
    if logits_workspace.ndim == 2:
        logits = (
            logits_workspace
            if num_queries == logits_workspace.shape[0]
            else logits_workspace[:num_queries]
        )
    else:
        # Preserve direct private-helper calls using the original flat buffer.
        logits = logits_workspace[: num_queries * logits_width].view(
            num_queries, logits_width
        )
    if launch_metadata is None:
        launch_metadata = _prefill_score_metadata(q, k_cache, page_table)
    strides, layout, constants = launch_metadata
    # Keep the measured compact gate: avoid binary-search overhead for
    # uniform requests, small chunks and the two-request regression cases.
    compact = _compact_eligible(q.shape[0], layout[0], max_query_len, num_queries)
    if compact:
        kernel = _qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel
        grid = lambda meta: (
            num_queries // meta["TILE_R"] + layout[0],
            1,
            triton.cdiv(logits_width, meta["BLOCK_N"] * meta["K_TILES"]),
        )
    else:
        kernel = (
            _qsa_prefill_fp8_store_score_kernel
            if _fp8_store_eligible(q, logits, logits_width)
            else _qsa_prefill_score_kernel
        )
        grid = lambda meta: (
            layout[0],
            triton.cdiv(min(num_queries, max_query_len), meta["TILE_R"]),
            triton.cdiv(logits_width, meta["BLOCK_N"] * meta["K_TILES"]),
        )
    kernel[grid](
        q,
        k_cache,
        page_table,
        query_start_loc,
        visible_blocks,
        logits,
        *strides,
        num_queries,
        query_offset,
        max_query_len,
        logits_width,
        *layout,
        **constants,
    )
    return logits


def qsa_select_paged_prefill(
    q: torch.Tensor,
    k_cache: torch.Tensor,
    page_table: torch.Tensor,
    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
    visible_blocks: torch.Tensor,
    token_topk: int,
    compress_ratio: int,
    max_query_len: int,
    block_indices: torch.Tensor,
    max_seq_len: int,
) -> None:
    """Write logical compressed-block indices selected for packed prefill Q.

    Matching BF16/FP8 Q is [tokens,H,D], K is [pages,page_size,1,D], H,D>0.
    Heads and dimensions are inferred from Q; compilation must fit device
    resources. Padded head/dimension lanes do not contribute to the score.
    ``query_start_loc``
    is [requests+1] and its first entry may be nonzero. Caller-provided
    ``visible_blocks`` is int32 [tokens]. ``block_indices`` is contiguous
    int32 [tokens,token_topk//compress_ratio]. Short rows are padded with -1.
    The caller must supply valid device-resident metadata and finite Q/K.
    Only logits workspace is limited by VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB;
    zero requests one row per chunk, as in vLLM. At least one logits row is
    allocated, and the existing Top-K operator allocates additional scratch.
    """
    rows, k = _validate_inputs(
        q,
        k_cache,
        page_table,
        query_start_loc,
        visible_blocks,
        token_topk,
        compress_ratio,
        max_query_len,
        block_indices,
        max_seq_len,
    )
    if rows == 0:
        return
    capacity = page_table.shape[1] * k_cache.shape[1]
    visible_bound = min(capacity, triton.cdiv(max_seq_len, compress_ratio))
    with torch.cuda.device(q.device):
        if visible_bound <= k:
            _select_all_kernel[(rows, triton.cdiv(k, 256))](
                visible_blocks, block_indices, K=k, BLOCK=256, num_warps=4
            )
            return
        try:
            budget_mb = int(os.environ.get("VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB", "512"))
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                "VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB must be an integer"
            ) from exc
        if budget_mb < 0:
            raise ValueError("VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB must be nonnegative")
        logits_width = min(capacity, triton.cdiv(max(64, visible_bound), 64) * 64)
        rows_per_chunk = min(
            rows, max(1, budget_mb * 1024 * 1024 // (logits_width * 4))
        )
        workspace = torch.empty(
            (rows_per_chunk, logits_width), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device
        )
        topk_workspace = torch.empty((1024 * 1024,), dtype=torch.uint8, device=q.device)
        launch_metadata = _prefill_score_metadata(q, k_cache, page_table)
        for query_offset in range(0, rows, rows_per_chunk):
            num_queries = min(rows_per_chunk, rows - query_offset)
            logits = _prefill_logits(
                q,
                k_cache,
                page_table,
                query_start_loc,
                visible_blocks,
                workspace,
                max_query_len,
                logits_width,
                query_offset,
                num_queries,
                launch_metadata=launch_metadata,
            )
            query_slice = slice(query_offset, query_offset + num_queries)
            persistent_topk(
                logits,
                visible_blocks[query_slice],
                block_indices[query_slice],
                topk_workspace,
                k=k,
                max_seq_len=logits_width,
            )


__all__ = ["qsa_select_paged_prefill"]

"""Private original scorer with explicit one-tile K lookahead and masked drain."""

import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_rows", "query_offset", "max_query_len"])
def _explicit_prefetch_score_kernel(
    q_ptr,
    cache_ptr,
    table_ptr,
    starts_ptr,
    visible_ptr,
    logits_ptr,
    stride_q_row,
    stride_q_head,
    stride_cache_block,
    stride_cache_token,
    stride_table_req,
    stride_table_page,
    num_rows,
    query_offset,
    max_query_len,
    logits_width,
    num_requests,
    num_pages,
    table_width,
    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
    NUM_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
    IS_FP8: tl.constexpr,
    TILE_R: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
    K_TILES: tl.constexpr,
    HEAD_GROUP: tl.constexpr = False,
):
    request = tl.program_id(0)
    query_base = tl.load(starts_ptr)
    request_start = tl.maximum(tl.load(starts_ptr + request) - query_base, query_offset)
    request_end = tl.minimum(
        tl.load(starts_ptr + request + 1) - query_base, query_offset + num_rows
    )
    row_start = request_start + tl.program_id(1) * TILE_R
    if row_start >= request_end:
        return

    GROUP_HEADS: tl.constexpr = (
        HEAD_GROUP
        and not IS_FP8
        and NUM_HEADS == 4
        and HEAD_DIM == 128
        and TILE_R == 64
    )
    HEADS_PADDED: tl.constexpr = 2 if GROUP_HEADS else triton.next_power_of_2(NUM_HEADS)
    # tl.dot requires N>=16 even when TILE_R * HEADS_PADDED is smaller.
    # Fake rows do not read queries/metadata or write outside this query tile.
    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr = max(TILE_R, triton.cdiv(16, HEADS_PADDED))
    row_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
    rows = row_start + row_lanes
    valid_rows = (row_lanes < TILE_R) & (rows < request_end)
    visible = tl.load(visible_ptr + rows, mask=valid_rows, other=0)
    max_visible = tl.minimum(tl.max(visible, axis=0), logits_width)
    first_tile = tl.program_id(2) * K_TILES
    if first_tile * BLOCK_N >= max_visible:
        return
    last_tile = tl.minimum(first_tile + K_TILES, tl.cdiv(max_visible, BLOCK_N))

    # Padded heads are adjacent in the dot result. Mask them before reduction.
    query_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R * HEADS_PADDED)
    query_row_lanes = query_lanes // HEADS_PADDED
    query_rows = row_start + query_row_lanes
    heads = query_lanes % HEADS_PADDED
    # Pad the reduction dimension to the native dot instruction's minimum.
    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr = max(32 if IS_FP8 else 16, triton.next_power_of_2(HEAD_DIM))
    dims = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
    query = tl.load(
        q_ptr
        + query_rows[None, :] * stride_q_row
        + heads[None, :] * stride_q_head
        + dims[:, None],
        mask=(query_row_lanes[None, :] < TILE_R)
        & (query_rows[None, :] < request_end)
        & (heads[None, :] < NUM_HEADS)
        & (dims[:, None] < HEAD_DIM),
        other=0.0,
    )
    if GROUP_HEADS:
        query_high = tl.load(
            q_ptr
            + query_rows[None, :] * stride_q_row
            + (heads[None, :] + 2) * stride_q_head
            + dims[:, None],
            mask=(query_row_lanes[None, :] < TILE_R)
            & (query_rows[None, :] < request_end)
            & (heads[None, :] < NUM_HEADS)
            & (dims[:, None] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
    column_lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
    columns = first_tile * BLOCK_N + column_lanes
    logical_page = columns // PAGE_SIZE
    page_offset = columns % PAGE_SIZE
    live = (columns < max_visible) & (logical_page < table_width)
    physical_page = tl.load(
        table_ptr + request * stride_table_req + logical_page * stride_table_page,
        mask=live,
        other=0,
    )
    live &= (physical_page >= 0) & (physical_page < num_pages)
    keys = tl.load(
        cache_ptr
        + physical_page[:, None].to(tl.int64) * stride_cache_block
        + page_offset[:, None] * stride_cache_token
        + dims[None, :],
        mask=live[:, None] & (dims[None, :] < HEAD_DIM),
        other=0.0,
    )
    for tile in tl.range(first_tile, last_tile, num_stages=1):
        next_columns = (tile + 1) * BLOCK_N + column_lanes
        next_logical_page = next_columns // PAGE_SIZE
        next_page_offset = next_columns % PAGE_SIZE
        next_live = (
            (tile + 1 < last_tile)
            & (next_columns < max_visible)
            & (next_logical_page < table_width)
        )
        next_physical_page = tl.load(
            table_ptr
            + request * stride_table_req
            + next_logical_page * stride_table_page,
            mask=next_live,
            other=0,
        )
        next_live &= (next_physical_page >= 0) & (next_physical_page < num_pages)
        next_keys = tl.load(
            cache_ptr
            + next_physical_page[:, None].to(tl.int64) * stride_cache_block
            + next_page_offset[:, None] * stride_cache_token
            + dims[None, :],
            mask=next_live[:, None] & (dims[None, :] < HEAD_DIM),
            other=0.0,
        )
        if GROUP_HEADS:
            low = tl.dot(keys, query, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            low = tl.sum(
                tl.maximum(tl.reshape(low, (BLOCK_N, BLOCK_R, 2)), 0.0), axis=2
            )
            high = tl.dot(keys, query_high, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            high = tl.sum(
                tl.maximum(tl.reshape(high, (BLOCK_N, BLOCK_R, 2)), 0.0), axis=2
            )
            scores = low + high
        else:
            scores = tl.dot(keys, query, out_dtype=tl.float32)
            scores = tl.reshape(scores, (BLOCK_N, BLOCK_R, HEADS_PADDED))
            real_heads = tl.arange(0, HEADS_PADDED) < NUM_HEADS
            scores = tl.where(real_heads[None, None, :], tl.maximum(scores, 0.0), 0.0)
            scores = tl.sum(scores, axis=2)
        tl.store(
            logits_ptr
            + (rows - query_offset)[None, :] * logits_width
            + columns[:, None],
            tl.where(live[:, None], scores, -float("inf")),
            mask=valid_rows[None, :]
            & (columns[:, None] < visible[None, :])
            & (columns[:, None] < logits_width),
        )
        columns = next_columns
        live = next_live
        keys = next_keys

import argparse
