def source(kind):
    path = ROOT / (OP if kind == "production" else EXPLICIT)
    expected = PRODUCTION_SHA if kind == "production" else EXPLICIT_SHA
    if trace.sha(path) != expected:
        raise RuntimeError("Frozen source changed: " + str(path))
    original = path.read_text()
    name = (
        "_qsa_prefill_score_kernel"
        if kind == "production"
        else "_explicit_prefetch_score_kernel"
    )
    fn = next(
        n
        for n in ast.parse(original).body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name
    )
    text = ast.get_source_segment(original, fn)
    text = text.replace("def " + name + "(", "def _qsa_prefill_score_kernel(", 1)
    if kind == "stages2":
        old = "tl.range(first_tile, last_tile, num_stages=1)"
        if text.count(old) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected explicit lookahead iterator")
        changed = text.replace(old, old.replace("=1", "=2"))
        if changed.replace("num_stages=2", "num_stages=1") != text:
            raise RuntimeError("Changed non-stage source")
        text = changed
    elif kind not in ("production", "stages1"):
        raise RuntimeError("Unknown source variant")
    return (
        "import triton\nimport triton.language as tl\n\n"
        '@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_rows", "query_offset", "max_query_len"])\n'
        + text
        + "\n"
    )


def abi(ir, generated, inputs, constants):
    names = next(
        n for n in ast.parse(generated).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
    ).args.args
    names = [n.arg for n in names]
    header = next(
        line
        for line in ir.splitlines()
        if "tt.func public @_qsa_prefill_score_kernel(" in line
    )
    found = list(re.finditer(r"%(\w+): (!tt.ptr<\w+>|i32)", header))
    signature, attrs = {}, {}
    for i, match in enumerate(found):
        name, typ = match.groups()
        if name not in names or name in signature:
            raise RuntimeError("Unknown/duplicate runtime ABI argument")
        signature[name] = "*" + typ[8:-1] if typ.startswith("!tt.ptr<") else typ
        section = header[
            match.end() : (
                found[i + 1].start()
                if i + 1 < len(found)
                else header.index(" attributes ")
            )
        ]
        attribute = re.search(r"tt.divisibility = (\d+) : i32", section)
        if attribute:
            attrs[(names.index(name),)] = [("tt.divisibility", int(attribute[1]))]
    if (
        set(names[:19]) - set(signature) != {"stride_table_page"}
        or len(signature) != 18
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported captured ABI specialization")
    tensors = {v["argument"]: v for v in inputs}
    q, cache, table = (tensors[i] for i in (0, 1, 2))
    if (
        q["dtype"] != "torch.bfloat16"
        or cache["dtype"] != q["dtype"]
        or q["shape"][1:] != [4, 128]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported source profile")
    if cache["shape"][2:] != [1, 128] or table["stride"][1] != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported cache/table layout")
    fixed = dict(
        stride_table_page=1,
        PAGE_SIZE=cache["shape"][1],
        NUM_HEADS=q["shape"][1],
        HEAD_DIM=q["shape"][2],
        IS_FP8=False,
        **{k: constants[k] for k in ("TILE_R", "BLOCK_N", "K_TILES", "HEAD_GROUP")},
    )
    for name in fixed:
        signature[name] = "constexpr"
    if set(signature) != set(names):
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete source signature")
    return signature, fixed, attrs


def inspect(ir, ptx):
    try:
        return producer.inspect(ir, ptx)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        # Keep rejected source compilations observable, including register-load
        # and unrolled forms. Unknown schedules cannot pass the feasibility gate.
        clean = double.runtime.program(ptx)
        return dict(
            schedule_error=str(exc),
            K_slots=None,
            early_K_copies=0,
            dot_sites=len(re.findall(r"\bttng.warp_group_dot\b", ir)),
            waits=re.findall(r".*ttng.warp_group_dot_wait.*", ir),
            mma_sites=len(re.findall(r"\bwgmma.mma_async\.", clean)),
            async_copy_sites=len(
                re.findall(r"\bcp.async.(?:ca|cg).shared.global\b", clean)
            ),
        )


def gate(control, candidate):
    if candidate["schedule"].get("schedule_error"):
        return candidate["schedule"]["schedule_error"]
    reason = producer.gate(control, candidate)
    if reason:
        return reason
    if candidate["schedule"]["K_slots"] != 2:
        return "source does not produce two K slots"
    if candidate["shared_bytes"] > 106496 or candidate["registers_per_thread"] > 217:
        return "exceeds validated ring2 resource footprint"
    if candidate.get("protocol_error"):
        return candidate["protocol_error"]
    if candidate.get("PTX_protocol", {}).get("status") != "passed":
        return "no verified final PTX lifetime protocol"
    return None


def prepare(previous, report):
    summary = json.loads((previous / "double-buffer-runtime-summary.json").read_text())
    if summary["status"] != "passed" or summary["production_modified"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Requires successful ring2 runtime report")
    profile = next(
        v for v in summary["source"]["producer_profiles"] if v["case"] == CASE
    )
    compiled = previous / "compile"
    proof = json.loads((compiled / "double-buffer-summary.json").read_text())
    if proof["status"] != "compile_feasible_pending_accuracy":
        raise RuntimeError("Missing validated compiler report")
    for path, record in json.loads((compiled / "sources.json").read_text()).items():
        if trace.sha(ROOT / path) != record["sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Prior proof source changed")
    captured = compiled / (CASE + "-two")
    record = json.loads((captured / "result.json").read_text())
    if (
        record != profile["candidate"]
        or trace.sha(captured / "ptx.txt") != profile["candidate_ptx_sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Validated candidate changed")
    if trace.sha(captured / "kernel.cubin") != record["cubin_sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Validated binary changed")
    old = json.loads((captured / "spec.json").read_text())
    options = captured / "options.json"
    if trace.sha(options) != old["metadata_sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Captured options changed")
    case = json.loads((previous / (CASE + ".json")).read_text())
    baseline = case["kernels_before"]["baseline"][0]
    if case["status"] != "passed" or baseline != case["kernels_after"]["baseline"][0]:
        raise RuntimeError("Production profile changed during reference run")
    expected = dict(
        num_warps=4,
        num_stages=2,
        num_ctas=1,
        TILE_R=64,
        BLOCK_N=64,
        K_TILES=16,
        HEAD_GROUP=True,
    )
    if baseline["constants"] != expected or baseline["spill_count"] != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported fixed launch configuration")
    jobs = []
    for kind in ("production", "stages1", "stages2"):
        folder = report / kind
        folder.mkdir()
        text = source(kind)
        path = folder / "kernel.py"
        path.write_text(text)
        sig, fixed, attrs = abi(
            (captured / "input.ttgir").read_text(), text, case["inputs"], expected
        )
        (folder / "options.json").write_bytes(options.read_bytes())
        job = dict(
            kind=kind,
            directory=str(folder),
            module=str(path),
            module_sha256=trace.sha(path),
            signature=sig,
            constants=fixed,
            attrs=[[list(k), v] for k, v in attrs.items()],
            runtime=old["runtime"],
            metadata=str(folder / "options.json"),
            metadata_sha256=trace.sha(options),
            control_code_sha256=profile["control_code_sha256"],
            production_resources=baseline,
            positive_resources=record,
        )
        trace.save(folder / "spec.json", job)
        jobs.append(job)
    return jobs


@contextlib.contextmanager
def cuda_hints(module):
    """Select the explicit compile target without invoking device discovery.

    Keep the pinned FlagTree HintManager/handler/trigger unchanged. The only
    scoped state change is its otherwise lazily initialized backend selection.
    """
    path = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
    if trace.sha(path) != HINT_MANAGER_SHA:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported FlagTree hint-manager source")
    previous = module._global_hint_manager
    if previous is not None and previous.backend_name != "cuda":
        raise RuntimeError("Conflicting existing hint backend")
    try:
        if previous is None:
            module._global_hint_manager = module.HintManager("cuda")
        selected = module._global_hint_manager
        yield dict(
            backend=selected.backend_name,
            handler=type(selected.handler).__module__
            + "."
            + type(selected.handler).__qualname__,
            source=str(path),
            sha256=HINT_MANAGER_SHA,
            selection="explicit CUDA target;native handler;no device discovery",
        )
    finally:
        module._global_hint_manager = previous


def child(args):
    job = json.loads(Path(args.worker_spec).read_text())
    folder = Path(job["directory"])
    os.environ.update(
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
        TRITON_ALWAYS_COMPILE="1",
        TRITON_DUMP_PTXAS_LOG="1",
        TRITON_CACHE_DIR=str(folder / "cache"),
        MLIR_ENABLE_DUMP="0",
    )
    for name in (
        "TRITON_PTXAS_PATH",
        "TRITON_DISABLE_LINE_INFO",
        "TRITON_OVERRIDE_ARCH",
        "DISABLE_PTXAS_OPT",
        "PTXAS_OPTIONS",
    ):
        value = job["runtime"]["environment"].get(name)
        if value is None:
            os.environ.pop(name, None)
        else:
            os.environ[name] = value
    for name in (
        "TRITON_KERNEL_OVERRIDE",
        "TRITON_KERNEL_DUMP",
        "TRITON_OVERRIDE_DIR",
        "LLVM_IR_ENABLE_DUMP",
    ):
        os.environ.pop(name, None)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(args.flagtree).resolve()))
    import triton
    from triton.backends.compiler import GPUTarget
    from triton.compiler.compiler import ASTSource

    for name, expected in job["runtime"]["compiler_files"].items():
        path = Path(importlib.import_module(name).__file__).resolve()
        if (
            path != Path(expected["path"]).resolve()
            or trace.sha(path) != expected["sha256"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Compiler identity mismatch: " + name)
    if (
        trace.sha(triton.__file__) != job["runtime"]["triton_init_sha256"]
        or trace.sha(os.environ["TRITON_PTXAS_PATH"])
        != job["runtime"]["ptxas"]["sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Compiler/assembler changed")
    if (
        trace.sha(job["module"]) != job["module_sha256"]
        or trace.sha(job["metadata"]) != job["metadata_sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Source/options changed")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "qsa_source_" + job["kind"], job["module"]
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    metadata = json.loads(Path(job["metadata"]).read_text())
    if (
        metadata["target"] != dict(backend="cuda", arch=90, warp_size=32)
        or metadata.get("ir_override") is not None
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected target/override")
    src = ASTSource(
        module._qsa_prefill_score_kernel,
        job["signature"],
        job["constants"],
        {tuple(k): [tuple(v) for v in values] for k, values in job["attrs"]},
    )
    from triton.compiler import hint_manager

    with cuda_hints(hint_manager) as hints:
        print("Offline hint backend:", json.dumps(hints), flush=True)
        kernel = triton.compile(
            src,
            target=GPUTarget(**metadata["target"]),
            options=trace.restore_options(metadata),
        )
    for name in ("ttir", "ttgir", "llir", "ptx"):
        (folder / (name + ".txt")).write_text(kernel.asm[name])
    (folder / "kernel.cubin").write_bytes(kernel.asm["cubin"])
    result = dict(
        status="compiled",
        hint_backend=hints,
        gpu_kernel_executed=False,
        ptx_sha256=trace.sha(folder / "ptx.txt"),
        cubin_sha256=trace.sha(folder / "kernel.cubin"),
        code_sha256=double.runtime.code_sha(kernel.asm["ptx"]),
        shared_bytes=kernel.metadata.shared,
        schedule=inspect(kernel.asm["ttgir"], kernel.asm["ptx"]),
    )
    try:
        result["PTX_protocol"] = double.ptx_protocol(kernel.asm["ptx"])
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        result["protocol_error"] = str(exc)
    trace.save(folder / "result.json", result)
    return 0


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-report", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--flagtree", default="/opt/flagtree")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=300)
    parser.add_argument("--worker-spec")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.worker_spec:
        return child(args)
    report = Path(args.report_dir).resolve()
    report.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    summary = dict(
        status="preparing",
        gpu_kernel_executed=False,
        production_modified=False,
        timings={},
        jobs=[],
    )
    try:
        trace.save(
            report / "sources.json",
            {
                n: dict(text=(ROOT / n).read_text(), sha256=trace.sha(ROOT / n))
                for n in SOURCES
            },
        )
        jobs = prepare(Path(args.source_report).resolve(), report)
        for job in jobs:
            folder = Path(job["directory"])
            code = trace.run_job(
                [
                    sys.executable,
                    "-I",
                    str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                    *sys.argv[1:],
                    "--worker-spec",
                    str(folder / "spec.json"),
                ],
                dict(os.environ, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="", PYTHONNOUSERSITE="1"),
                folder / "compiler.txt",
                args.timeout,
            )
            if code or not (folder / "result.json").is_file():
                print(
                    "\n".join((folder / "compiler.txt").read_text().splitlines()[-40:]),
                    flush=True,
                )
                raise RuntimeError("Source compilation failed: " + job["kind"])
            result = json.loads((folder / "result.json").read_text())
            result.update(producer.resources((folder / "compiler.txt").read_text()))
            trace.save(folder / "result.json", result)
            summary["jobs"].append(
                dict(kind=job["kind"], exit_code=code, result=result)
            )
            print(
                job["kind"],
                "regs",
                result["registers_per_thread"],
                "shared",
                result["shared_bytes"],
                "K slots",
                result["schedule"]["K_slots"],
                "early K copies",
                result["schedule"]["early_K_copies"],
                "cp.async sites",
                result["schedule"]["async_copy_sites"],
                "MMA",
                result["schedule"]["mma_sites"],
                "spill bytes",
                result["spill_store_bytes"],
                result["spill_load_bytes"],
                flush=True,
            )
            if job["kind"] == "production":
                baseline = job["production_resources"]
                if (
                    result["code_sha256"] != job["control_code_sha256"]
                    or (result["registers_per_thread"], result["shared_bytes"])
                    != (baseline["registers_per_thread"], baseline["shared_bytes"])
                    or result["spill_store_bytes"]
                    or result["spill_load_bytes"]
                ):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "Original Python source did not reproduce production;do not interpret candidate"
                    )
            elif job["kind"] == "stages1":
                if (
                    result["registers_per_thread"],
                    result["shared_bytes"],
                    result["schedule"]["async_copy_sites"],
                    result["spill_store_bytes"],
                    result["spill_load_bytes"],
                ) != (215, 81920, 0, 0, 0):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "Source stages1 negative control did not reproduce known resources"
                    )
            else:
                reason = gate(summary["jobs"][0]["result"], result)
                summary.update(
                    status=(
                        "not_promising"
                        if reason
                        else "compile_promising_pending_lifetime_and_accuracy"
                    ),
                    reason=reason,
                )
                print(
                    "Decision:",
                    summary["status"],
                    "reason:",
                    reason,
                    "GPU executed:False;no timings",
                    flush=True,
                )
        return 0
    except BaseException:
        summary.update(status="failed", error=traceback.format_exc())
        print(summary["error"], flush=True)
        return 1
    finally:
        trace.save(report / "source-pipeline-summary.json", summary)
        with tarfile.open(
            report / "source-compile-artifacts.tar.gz", "w:gz"
        ) as archive:
            for folder in (report / n for n in ("production", "stages1", "stages2")):
                if folder.is_dir():
                    for path in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
                        if path.is_file():
                            archive.add(
                                path,
                                arcname=str(path.relative_to(report)),
                                recursive=False,
                            )
        print("Compile report:", report, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Check Python-source-only compilation, captured ABI and strict feasibility gates."""

import ast

from tools.test_qsa_prefill_producer_first import PTX, final_ir


class SourcePipelineTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_stage_two_changes_exactly_the_loop_stage_keyword(self):
        a, b = p.source("stages1"), p.source("stages2")
        self.assertEqual(b.replace("num_stages=2", "num_stages=1"), a)
        fn = next(n for n in ast.parse(a).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef))
        original = next(
            n
            for n in ast.parse((p.ROOT / p.EXPLICIT).read_text()).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
        )
        fn.name = original.name
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(fn), ast.dump(original))
        source = ast.parse((p.ROOT / p.OP).read_text())
        original = next(
            n
            for n in source.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "_qsa_prefill_score_kernel"
        )
        fn = next(
            n
            for n in ast.parse(p.source("production")).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
        )
        original.decorator_list = fn.decorator_list
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(fn), ast.dump(original))
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            p.source("other")

    def header(self):
        names = next(
            n
            for n in ast.parse(p.source("production")).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
        ).args.args
        return (
            "tt.func public @_qsa_prefill_score_kernel("
            + ", ".join(
                "%"
                + n.arg
                + (": !tt.ptr<bf16>" if i < 6 else ": i32")
                + (" {tt.divisibility = 16 : i32}" if i < 10 else "")
                + " loc(unknown)"
                for i, n in enumerate(names[:19])
                if n.arg != "stride_table_page"
            )
            + ") attributes {noinline=false} {"
        )

    def inputs(self):
        return [
            dict(argument=0, dtype="torch.bfloat16", shape=[16384, 4, 128]),
            dict(argument=1, dtype="torch.bfloat16", shape=[544, 196, 1, 128]),
            dict(argument=2, stride=[136, 1]),
        ]

    def test_captured_abi_keeps_runtime_parameters_and_only_specializes_known_one(self):
        constants = dict(TILE_R=64, BLOCK_N=64, K_TILES=16, HEAD_GROUP=True)
        sig, fixed, attrs = p.abi(
            self.header(), p.source("stages2"), self.inputs(), constants
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(sig), 27)
        self.assertEqual(sig["q_ptr"], "*bf16")
        self.assertEqual(sig["num_rows"], "i32")
        self.assertEqual(fixed["stride_table_page"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(fixed["PAGE_SIZE"], 196)
        self.assertEqual(attrs[(0,)], [("tt.divisibility", 16)])
        self.assertNotIn((12,), attrs)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            p.abi(
                self.header().replace("%num_rows: i32", "%unknown: i32"),
                p.source("stages2"),
                self.inputs(),
                constants,
            )
        bad = self.inputs()
        bad[2]["stride"] = [136, 2]
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            p.abi(self.header(), p.source("stages2"), bad, constants)

    def test_direct_register_loads_are_reported_and_never_pass_gate(self):
        text = final_ir(True).replace("ttg.async_copy_global_to_local", "tt.load")
        result = p.inspect(text, PTX)
        self.assertIn("schedule_error", result)
        self.assertEqual(result["early_K_copies"], 0)
        self.assertIsNotNone(p.gate({}, dict(schedule=result)))

    def test_gate_requires_async_work_two_slots_resources_and_protocol(self):
        schedule = dict(
            K_slots=2,
            early_K_copies=1,
            async_copy_sites=16,
            dot_sites=2,
            waits=[0, 0],
            mma_sites=16,
        )
        control = dict(
            schedule=schedule,
            shared_bytes=106496,
            registers_per_thread=207,
            spill_store_bytes=0,
            spill_load_bytes=0,
        )
        candidate = dict(
            control, registers_per_thread=217, PTX_protocol=dict(status="passed")
        )
        self.assertIsNone(p.gate(control, candidate))
        for bad in (
            dict(candidate, shared_bytes=122880),
            dict(candidate, registers_per_thread=218),
            dict(candidate, spill_store_bytes=8),
            dict(candidate, protocol_error="missing drain"),
            dict(candidate, PTX_protocol={}),
            dict(candidate, schedule=dict(schedule, K_slots=3)),
            dict(candidate, schedule=dict(schedule, early_K_copies=0)),
            dict(candidate, schedule=dict(schedule, mma_sites=8)),
        ):
            self.assertIsNotNone(p.gate(control, bad))

    def hint_module(self):
        result = types.SimpleNamespace(
            __file__="/tmp/hint_manager.py", _global_hint_manager=None
        )
        calls = []

        class Handler:
            def trigger(self, hook, value):
                calls.append((hook, value))
                return "native result"

        class Manager:
            def __init__(self, backend):
                calls.append(("construct", backend))
                self.backend_name, self.handler = backend, Handler()

        def trigger(hook, value):
            if result._global_hint_manager is None:
                raise AssertionError("Unexpected GPU driver discovery")
            return result._global_hint_manager.handler.trigger(hook, value)

        result.HintManager = Manager
        result.hint_trigger = trigger
        return result, calls

    def test_explicit_hint_backend_keeps_native_handler_without_driver_discovery(self):
        module, calls = self.hint_module()
        original = module.hint_trigger
        with patch.object(p.trace, "sha", return_value=p.HINT_MANAGER_SHA):
            with p.cuda_hints(module) as evidence:
                self.assertEqual(evidence["backend"], "cuda")
                self.assertIs(module.hint_trigger, original)

"""Compile-gated two-buffer producer-first accuracy and two-case stage A/B."""

import argparse
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from tools import qsa_prefill_double_buffer as double  # noqa: E402
from tools import qsa_prefill_producer_runtime as runtime  # noqa: E402

ORIGINAL_PROFILES = runtime.profiles
ORIGINAL_WORKER = runtime.worker


def profiles(*, allow_create=False):
    result = ORIGINAL_PROFILES(allow_create=allow_create)
    source = Path(os.environ["QSA_DOUBLE_BUFFER_REPORT"]).resolve()
    summary = json.loads((source / "double-buffer-summary.json").read_text())
    if (
        summary["status"] != "compile_feasible_pending_accuracy"
        or len(summary["jobs"]) != 4
        or len(summary["decisions"]) != 2
        or not all(v["reason"] is None for v in summary["decisions"])
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Both two-buffer compile gates must pass")
    sources = json.loads((source / "sources.json").read_text())
    if set(sources) != set(double.SOURCES) or any(
        double.trace.sha(ROOT / n) != v["sha256"] for n, v in sources.items()
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Two-buffer compiler proof source changed")
    proof = json.loads((source / "protocol-model.json").read_text())
    if (
        proof["status"] != "passed"
        or len(proof["checks"]) != 34
        or not all(v["safe"] for v in proof["checks"])
        or proof["missing_reuse_barrier_counterexample"]["safe"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete lifetime model proof")
    for capture in result:
        case = capture["case"]
        control, candidate = (
            source / (case + suffix) for suffix in ("-control", "-two")
        )
        a, b = (
            json.loads((p / "result.json").read_text()) for p in (control, candidate)
        )
        for folder, record in ((control, a), (candidate, b)):
            saved = next(j for j in summary["jobs"] if j["name"] == folder.name)
            if (
                saved["exit_code"]
                or saved["result"] != record
                or record["status"] != "compiled"
            ):
                raise RuntimeError("Invalid two-buffer compile record")
            if (
                double.trace.sha(folder / "ptx.txt") != record["ptx_sha256"]
                or double.trace.sha(folder / "kernel.cubin") != record["cubin_sha256"]
            ):
                raise RuntimeError("Two-buffer binary changed")
            if (
                double.ptx_protocol((folder / "ptx.txt").read_text())
                != record["PTX_protocol"]
            ):
                raise RuntimeError("PTX reuse protocol changed")
        if a["ptx_sha256"] != capture["candidate_ptx_sha256"] or double.gate(a, b):
            raise RuntimeError("Three-buffer control/two-buffer gate mismatch")
        original = (control / "input.ttgir").read_text()
        if double.trace.sha(control / "input.ttgir") != capture["override_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Captured three-buffer IR differs")
        changed, lifetime = double.two_slots(original)
        if (candidate / "input.ttgir").read_text() != changed:
            raise RuntimeError("Two-buffer IR changed non-ring instructions")
        spec = json.loads((candidate / "spec.json").read_text())
        if (
            spec["lifetime_proof"] != lifetime
            or double.trace.sha(candidate / "input.ttgir") != spec["ir_sha256"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Ring rewrite proof changed")
        path = Path(os.environ["QSA_PRODUCER_RUNTIME_REPORT"]) / (
            "double-buffer-" + case + ".ttgir"
        )
        if path.exists() and path.read_text() != changed:
            raise RuntimeError("Prepared two-buffer IR changed")
        if not path.exists():
            if not allow_create:
                raise RuntimeError("Prepared two-buffer IR disappeared")
            path.write_text(changed)
        capture.update(
            candidate=b,
            candidate_ptx_sha256=b["ptx_sha256"],
            override_file=str(path),
            override_sha256=double.trace.sha(path),
            variant="two_buffer_producer_first",
            lifetime_proof=lifetime,
            lifetime_model_sha256=double.trace.sha(source / "protocol-model.json"),
            compile_summary_sha256=double.trace.sha(
                source / "double-buffer-summary.json"
            ),
            three_buffer_control_ptx_sha256=a["ptx_sha256"],
        )
    return result


def worker(options):
    code = ORIGINAL_WORKER(options)
    path = Path(options.report_dir) / (options.worker_case + ".json")
    if path.is_file():
        result = json.loads(path.read_text())
        result["algorithm"] = "producer_first_two_buffer_verified_IR"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    return code


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--double-buffer-report", default=os.environ.get("QSA_DOUBLE_BUFFER_REPORT")
    )
    parser.add_argument("--compile-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--compile-timeout", type=int, default=300)
    own, remaining = parser.parse_known_args()
    if any(v in remaining for v in ("-h", "--help")):
        print(
            __doc__
            + "\nExtra flags: --compile-only, --compile-timeout, --double-buffer-report"
        )
        sys.argv = [sys.argv[0], *remaining]
        return runtime.main()
    read = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    read.add_argument("--report-dir", required=True)
    read.add_argument(
        "--producer-report", default=os.environ.get("QSA_PRODUCER_REPORT")
    )
    read.add_argument("--flagtree", default="/opt/flagtree")
    values, _ = read.parse_known_args(remaining)
    if not values.producer_report:
        read.error("--producer-report is required")
    report = Path(values.report_dir).resolve()
    report.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    compiled = (
        Path(own.double_buffer_report).resolve()
        if own.double_buffer_report
        else report / "compile"
    )
    if not own.double_buffer_report:
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            "-I",
            str(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_double_buffer.py"),
            "--report-dir",
            str(compiled),
            "--source-report",
            str(Path(values.producer_report).resolve()),
            "--flagtree",
            values.flagtree,
            "--timeout",
            str(own.compile_timeout),
        ]
        # Inherit stdout for visible compile/proof results. The compiler's own
        # child processes use CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" and explicit SM90 target.
        import subprocess

        code = subprocess.call(command)
    else:
        code = 0
    for name, new in (
        ("double-buffer-summary.json", "double-buffer-compile-summary.json"),
        ("compile-artifacts.tar.gz", "double-buffer-compile-artifacts.tar.gz"),
    ):
        if (compiled / name).is_file():
            shutil.copyfile(compiled / name, report / new)
    path = compiled / "double-buffer-summary.json"
    summary = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    if (
        code
        or summary.get("status") != "compile_feasible_pending_accuracy"
        or own.compile_only
    ):
        double.trace.save(
            report / "double-buffer-runtime-summary.json",
            dict(
                status=(
                    "failed"
                    if code
                    else "compile_only" if own.compile_only else "compile_not_promising"
                ),
                compile_status=summary.get("status"),
                gpu_kernel_executed=False,
                timings={},
            ),
        )
        print(
            "Stopped before GPU execution;compile status:",
            summary.get("status"),
            flush=True,
        )
        return code
    os.environ["QSA_DOUBLE_BUFFER_REPORT"] = str(compiled)
    sys.argv = [sys.argv[0], *remaining]
    is_worker = "--worker-case" in remaining
    with patch.object(runtime, "profiles", profiles), patch.object(
        runtime, "worker", worker
    ), patch.object(runtime, "__file__", str(Path(__file__).resolve())), patch.object(
        runtime, "__doc__", __doc__
    ), patch.object(
        runtime, "EXTRA_SOURCES", runtime.EXTRA_SOURCES | set(double.SOURCES)
    ):
        code = runtime.main()
    if not is_worker:
        path = report / "producer-runtime-summary.json"
        if path.is_file():
            path.replace(report / "double-buffer-runtime-summary.json")
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

IR = """module {
  %zero = arith.constant 0 : i32
  %minus = arith.constant -1 : i32
  %one = arith.constant 1 : i32
  %three = arith.constant 3 : i32
  %buf = ttg.local_alloc : () -> !ttg.memdesc<3x64x128xbf16, #shared>
  %initial = ttg.memdesc_index %buf[%zero] : !ttg.memdesc<3x64x128xbf16, #shared>
  %copy0 = ttg.async_copy_global_to_local %p, %initial : tensor<64x128x!tt.ptr<bf16>, #blocked>
  %commit0 = ttg.async_commit_group tokens %copy0
  %result:3 = scf.for %i = %zero to %last step %one iter_args(%w = %zero, %r = %minus, %token = %commit0) -> (i32) {
    %wadd = arith.addi %w, %one : i32
    %wcmp = arith.cmpi sge, %wadd, %three : i32
    %wi = arith.select %wcmp, %zero, %wadd : i32
    %radd = arith.addi %r, %one : i32
    %rcmp = arith.cmpi sge, %radd, %three : i32
    %ri = arith.select %rcmp, %zero, %radd : i32
    %write = ttg.memdesc_index %buf[%wi] : !ttg.memdesc<3x64x128xbf16, #shared>
    %read = ttg.memdesc_index %buf[%ri] : !ttg.memdesc<3x64x128xbf16, #shared>
    %copy = ttg.async_copy_global_to_local %p, %write : tensor<64x128x!tt.ptr<bf16>, #blocked>
    %commit = ttg.async_commit_group tokens %copy
    %wait = ttg.async_wait %token {num = 1 : i32}
    %dot = ttng.warp_group_dot %read, %q
    %done = ttng.warp_group_dot_wait %dot {pendings = 0 : i32}
    tt.store %o, %done
    scf.yield %wi, %ri, %commit : i32, i32, !ttg.async.token
  }
  ttg.local_dealloc %buf : !ttg.memdesc<3x64x128xbf16, #shared>
}
"""
PTX = """.visible .entry score() {
L0:
cp.async.cg.shared.global [%r1], [%rd1], 0x10;
cp.async.commit_group;
cp.async.wait_group 1;
bar.sync 0;
wgmma.mma_async.sync.aligned.m64n64k16.f32.bf16.bf16 x;
wgmma.wait_group.sync.aligned 0;
bar.sync 0;
@%p1 bra L0;
cp.async.wait_group 0;
bar.sync 0;
ret;
}
"""


class DoubleBufferTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_model_and_unsafe_negative_controls(self):
        result = probe.protocol_model()
        self.assertEqual(len(result["checks"]), 34)
        self.assertEqual(result["states"], 4322)
        self.assertTrue(all(v["safe"] for v in result["checks"]))
        self.assertFalse(result["missing_reuse_barrier_counterexample"]["safe"])
        self.assertTrue(result["missing_reuse_barrier_counterexample"]["witness"])
        self.assertFalse(probe.model(1, 1, slots=1)["safe"])
        self.assertTrue(probe.model(16, 2, slots=3, reuse_barrier=False)["safe"])

    def test_rewrite_changes_only_ring_dimension_and_two_bounds(self):
        changed, proof = probe.two_slots(IR)
        self.assertEqual(changed.count("memdesc<2x64x128xbf16"), 5)
        self.assertEqual(proof["local_type_replacements"], 5)
        restored = changed.replace("  %qsa_ring_two = arith.constant 2 : i32\n", "")
        restored = restored.replace("memdesc<2x64x128xbf16", "memdesc<3x64x128xbf16")
        restored = restored.replace(", %qsa_ring_two : i32", ", %three : i32")
        self.assertEqual(restored, IR)
        self.assertIn("%three = arith.constant 3 : i32", changed)
        for bad in (
            IR.replace("{num = 1", "{num = 0"),
            IR.replace("%r = %minus", "%r = %zero"),
            IR.replace("scf.yield %wi, %ri", "scf.yield %ri, %wi"),
            IR.replace(
                "%commit0 = ttg.async_commit_group tokens %copy0", "%commit0 = other"
            ),
            IR.replace("  ttg.local_dealloc", "  tt.use %buf\n  ttg.local_dealloc"),
            IR.replace("3x64x128xbf16", "3x32x128xbf16"),
            IR + IR,
        ):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad), self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                probe.two_slots(bad)

    def test_final_ptx_requires_complete_cta_lifetime_protocol(self):
        result = probe.ptx_protocol(PTX)
        self.assertEqual(result["post_WGMMA_CTA_barriers"], 1)
        self.assertTrue(result["epilogue_drain"])
        for bad in (
            PTX.replace("@%p1 bra", "bra"),
            PTX.replace("L0:\n", "L0:\nbra L1;\nL1:\n"),
            PTX.replace("aligned 0;\nbar.sync 0;", "aligned 0;"),
            PTX.replace("wait_group 1;", "wait_group 2;"),
            PTX.replace("wait_group 1;\nbar.sync 0;", "wait_group 1;"),
            PTX.replace("cp.async.wait_group 0;", "cp.async.wait_group 1;"),
            PTX.replace("0x10;", "0x8;"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad), self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):

    def test_resource_gate_rejects_spills_work_or_wrong_shared_reduction(self):
        schedule = dict(
            K_slots=3,
            mma_sites=8,
            dot_sites=1,
            waits=[0],
            async_copy_sites=1,
            early_K_copies=1,
        )
        control = dict(
            schedule=schedule,
            shared_bytes=90112,
            spill_store_bytes=0,
            spill_load_bytes=0,
        )
        candidate = dict(
            control, schedule=dict(schedule, K_slots=2), shared_bytes=73728
        )
        self.assertIsNone(probe.gate(control, candidate))
        for bad in (
            dict(candidate, shared_bytes=90112),
            dict(candidate, spill_load_bytes=8),
            dict(candidate, schedule=dict(schedule, K_slots=3)),
            dict(candidate, schedule=dict(schedule, K_slots=2, mma_sites=9)),
            dict(candidate, schedule=dict(schedule, K_slots=2, early_K_copies=0)),
        ):
            self.assertIsNotNone(probe.gate(control, bad))

    def run_adapter(self, status, compile_only=False, existing=False, worker=False):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            report = Path(directory)
            compiled = report / "compile"
            compiled.mkdir()
            (compiled / "double-buffer-summary.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(dict(status=status))
            )
            argv = ["driver", "--report-dir", directory, "--producer-report", directory]
            if compile_only:
                argv += ["--compile-only"]
            if existing:
                argv += ["--double-buffer-report", str(compiled)]
            if worker:
                argv += ["--worker-case", "case"]
            with patch.object(sys, "argv", argv), patch.dict(
                os.environ, {}, clear=True
            ), patch("subprocess.call", return_value=0) as compile_call, patch.object(
                runtime.runtime, "main", return_value=0
            ) as execute:

                self.assertEqual(code, 0)

                        (report / "double-buffer-runtime-summary.json").read_text()
                    )
                    self.assertFalse(summary["gpu_kernel_executed"])
                else:

                self.assertEqual(compile_call.call_count, 0 if existing else 1)

    def test_compile_gate_precedes_runtime_and_reuses_completed_compilations(self):
        self.run_adapter("not_promising")
        self.run_adapter("compile_feasible_pending_accuracy", compile_only=True)
        self.run_adapter("compile_feasible_pending_accuracy")
        self.run_adapter(
            "compile_feasible_pending_accuracy", existing=True, worker=True
        )

    def test_compiler_path_has_no_gpu_execution_or_driver_resource_queries(self):

## Paths board

## Extracted lifetime argument

For iteration i,the copied tile is i+1 and the consumed tile is i. With B slots,
write=(i+1)%B and read=i%B. With B=2,the destination last held tile i-1.
That tile's DMA had completed before its consumers started. All its WGMMA reads
have completed before every participating thread crosses the previous iteration's
post-result CTA barrier. Thus a thread entering iteration i cannot overwrite a
slot still read by another warp group from iteration i-1. Current K and next K
remain in different slots. The existing current-copy wait and pre-MMA CTA barrier
publish the whole current tile;the existing epilogue drains pending copies.

R32 requires explicit attention to two warp groups. Per-group WGMMA wait0 alone
is not a full-CTA reuse guarantee. The post-result bar.sync0 is therefore a hard
proof/generation gate. The negative model omits the reuse barrier and assumes no
additional pre-copy reuse barrier:it demonstrates a potential cross-group clobber,
not that deleting just one barrier in the archived PTX necessarily produces it.

Why three slots:LowerLoops.getDefUseStageDiff adds a wrap-stage adjustment when
consumer cluster follows producer cluster;loadRequiresAdditionalBuffer adds a
further WGMMA lifetime slot. Producer-first yields2+1=3. These generic rules do
not use the later materialization waits and output-layout conversion's CTA
barrier to shorten this particular kernel's lifetime. This probe tests a narrow
post-lowering opportunity and does not declare the generic rule incorrect.

PTX synchronization semantics reference:
https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/index.html

The new six CPU tests and the prior 24 protocol/runtime tests pass. The model
checks 34 configurations and 4,322 reachable states. Both actual archived H800
producer IR/PTX pairs pass the structural proof and produce four replay inputs;
their archived files remain unchanged. CLI help and bash syntax checks pass.
Repository hook versions are run from the installed cache because the GitCode
mirror cannot resolve in this sandbox. No CUDA compilation or kernel execution
has been performed on the Mac. Compile success, runtime correctness and speedup
remain separate pending card results.

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""Compile-only producer-first cluster probe; no GPU kernel execution."""

import argparse
import ast
import copy
import importlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import tarfile
import traceback
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from tools import qsa_prefill_pipeline_trace as trace  # noqa: E402

SOURCES = (
    "tools/qsa_prefill_producer_first.py",
    "tools/test_qsa_prefill_producer_first.py",
    "tools/run_qsa_prefill_producer_first.sh",
    "docs/qsa_prefill_producer_first_probe.md",
    "tools/qsa_prefill_pipeline_trace.py",
)


def snapshot(text):
    headers = list(re.finditer(r"^//.*IR Dump (?:Before|After).*$", text, re.M))
    matches = [i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if "Before TritonGPUPipeline " in h[0]]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Requires exactly one pre-pipeline snapshot")
    i = matches[0]
    return (
        text[
            headers[i].end() : (
                headers[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(headers) else len(text)
            )
        ].strip()
        + "\n"
    )


def producer_first(text):
    cluster = r"loop\.cluster = (-?\d+) : i32"
    if set(re.findall(cluster, text)) != {"0", "1"} or set(
        re.findall(r"loop\.stage = (-?\d+) : i32", text)
    ) != {"0", "1"}:
        raise RuntimeError("Requires the original two-stage/two-cluster schedule")
    if len(re.findall(r"\bscf.for\b", text)) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Requires one original score loop")
    result, count = re.subn(
        cluster, lambda m: "loop.cluster = " + str(1 - int(m[1])) + " : i32", text
    )
    if count < 2:
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete cluster rewrite")
    return result, count


def resume_function(source, namespace):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    cls = next(
        n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "CUDABackend"
    )
    fn = copy.deepcopy(
        next(
            n
            for n in cls.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "make_ttgir"
        )
    )
    if [n.arg for n in fn.args.args] != ["mod", "metadata", "opt", "capability"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported backend method signature")
    branches = [
        (i, n)
        for i, n in enumerate(fn.body)
        if isinstance(n, ast.If) and ast.unparse(n.test) == "capability // 10 in [8, 9]"
    ]
    if len(branches) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported SM90 pipeline structure")
    index, branch = branches[0]
    calls = [
        n
        for n in branch.body
        if isinstance(n, ast.Expr)
        and isinstance(n.value, ast.Call)
        and ast.unparse(n.value.func) == "passes.ttgpuir.add_pipeline"
    ]
    if (
        len(calls) != 1
        or ast.unparse(calls[0].value)
        != "passes.ttgpuir.add_pipeline(pm, opt.num_stages, dump_enabled)"
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported pipeline entry")
    fn.name = "_qsa_resume_ttgir"
    fn.decorator_list = []
    fn.body = (
        ast.parse(
            "pm = ir.pass_manager(mod.context)\ndump_enabled = pm.enable_debug()\n"
        ).body
        + copy.deepcopy(calls)
        + fn.body[index + 1 :]
    )
    adapted = ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[fn], type_ignores=[]))
    scope = dict(namespace)
    exec(compile(adapted, "<private-qsa-compiler-tail>", "exec"), scope)
    return scope[fn.name], ast.unparse(adapted) + "\n"


def inspect(ir, ptx):
    lines = ir.splitlines()
    loops = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"\bscf.for\b", line)]
    if len(loops) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Unidentified main loop")
    start = loops[0]
    indent = len(lines[start]) - len(lines[start].lstrip())
    end = next(
        i
        for i in range(start + 1, len(lines))
        if lines[i].startswith(" " * indent + "}")
    )
    body = lines[start + 1 : end]
    dots = [
        i for i, line in enumerate(body) if re.search(r"\bttng.warp_group_dot\b", line)
    ]
    copies = [
        i
        for i, line in enumerate(body)
        if "ttg.async_copy_global_to_local" in line
        and "tensor<64x128x!tt.ptr<bf16>" in line
    ]
    waits = [line.strip() for line in body if "ttng.warp_group_dot_wait" in line]
    slots = 0
    for line in lines:
        m = (
            re.search(r"memdesc<((?:\d+x)+)bf16", line)
            if "ttg.local_alloc" in line
            else None
        )
        if m:
            dims = [int(v) for v in m[1].rstrip("x").split("x")]
            if dims[-2:] == [64, 128]:
                n = 1
                for d in dims[:-2]:
                    n *= d
                slots += n
    if not dots or len(copies) != 1 or not waits:
        raise RuntimeError("Unidentified K-copy/dot/wait schedule")
    clean = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/|//[^\n]*", "", ptx, flags=re.S)
    return dict(
        K_slots=slots,
        early_K_copies=sum(i < dots[0] for i in copies),
        K_copy_line=start + 2 + copies[0],
        first_dot_line=start + 2 + dots[0],
        dot_sites=len(dots),
        waits=waits,
        mma_sites=len(re.findall(r"\bwgmma.mma_async\.", clean)),
        async_copy_sites=len(
            re.findall(r"\bcp.async.(?:ca|cg).shared.global\b", clean)
        ),
    )


def resources(text):
    regs = set(int(v) for v in re.findall(r"Used (\d+) registers", text))
    spill = set(
        (int(a), int(b))
        for a, b in re.findall(
            r"(\d+) bytes spill stores, (\d+) bytes spill loads", text
        )
    )
    if len(regs) != 1 or len(spill) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Unknown/ambiguous PTXAS register or spill resources")
    stores, loads = next(iter(spill))
    return dict(
        registers_per_thread=next(iter(regs)),
        spill_store_bytes=stores,
        spill_load_bytes=loads,
    )


def gate(control, candidate):
    a, b = control["schedule"], candidate["schedule"]
    if candidate["spill_store_bytes"] or candidate["spill_load_bytes"]:
        return "candidate spills"
    if a["mma_sites"] != b["mma_sites"] or a["dot_sites"] != b["dot_sites"]:
        return "matrix work changed"
    if len(a["waits"]) != len(b["waits"]):
        return "WGMMA materialization wait count changed"
    if not b["async_copy_sites"] or not b["early_K_copies"]:
        return "no early hardware-async K copy"
    if b["K_slots"] not in (2, 3):
        return "unexpected K buffer count"
    return None


def prepare(source, report):
    summary = json.loads((source / "pipeline-trace-summary.json").read_text())
    if (
        summary["status"] != "passed"
        or len(summary["jobs"]) != 4
        or summary["gpu_kernel_executed"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Requires successful four-way compile-only trace")
    expected_names = {
        case + "-" + side for case in trace.CASES for side in ("baseline", "candidate")
    }
    if {j["name"] for j in summary["jobs"]} != expected_names or any(
        j["exit_code"]
        or not all(j["coverage"].values())
        or j["result"]["status"] != "passed"
        or j["result"]["actual_ptx_sha256"] != j["result"]["expected_ptx_sha256"]
        for j in summary["jobs"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete four-way trace identity")
    jobs = []
    for case in trace.CASES:
        old = source / (case + "-baseline")
        spec = json.loads((old / "spec.json").read_text())
        prior = next(j for j in summary["jobs"] if j["name"] == old.name)
        if (
            prior["exit_code"]
            or not all(prior["coverage"].values())
            or prior["result"]["status"] != "passed"
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Unvalidated captured production trace")
        if (
            trace.sha(old / "replayed-ptx.txt") != spec["expected_ptx_sha256"]
            or prior["result"]["actual_ptx_sha256"] != spec["expected_ptx_sha256"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Captured PTX identity changed")
        if spec["original_resources"]["constants"]["num_stages"] != 2:
            raise RuntimeError("Requires original production stage2")
        original = snapshot((old / "passes.txt").read_text())
        changed, count = producer_first(original)
        metadata = old / Path(spec["metadata"]).name
        if trace.sha(metadata) != spec["metadata_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Captured compiler options changed")
        for kind, text in (("control", original), ("producer", changed)):
            folder = report / (case + "-" + kind)
            folder.mkdir()
            # .ttir selects the patched TTGPU resume entry; its content is the
            # already-scheduled GPU IR. No TTIR/early GPU passes are repeated.
            ir = folder / "scheduled.ttir"
            ir.write_text(text)
            meta = folder / "options.json"
            meta.write_bytes(metadata.read_bytes())
            job = dict(
                spec,
                name=folder.name,
                directory=str(folder),
                kind=kind,
                ir=str(ir),
                ir_sha256=trace.sha(ir),
                metadata=str(meta),
                metadata_sha256=trace.sha(meta),
                cluster_changes=count if kind == "producer" else 0,
            )
            trace.save(folder / "spec.json", job)
            jobs.append(job)
    return jobs


def child(options):
    job = json.loads(Path(options.worker_spec).read_text())
    folder = Path(job["directory"])
    os.environ.update(
        MLIR_ENABLE_DUMP="1",
        MLIR_DUMP_PATH=str(folder / "passes.txt"),
        TRITON_ALWAYS_COMPILE="1",
        TRITON_DUMP_PTXAS_LOG="1",
        TRITON_CACHE_DIR=str(folder / "cache"),
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
    )
    for name in (
        "TRITON_PTXAS_PATH",
        "TRITON_DISABLE_LINE_INFO",
        "TRITON_OVERRIDE_ARCH",
        "DISABLE_PTXAS_OPT",
        "PTXAS_OPTIONS",
    ):
        value = job["runtime"]["environment"].get(name)
        if value is None:
            os.environ.pop(name, None)
        else:
            os.environ[name] = value
    for name in (
        "TRITON_KERNEL_OVERRIDE",
        "TRITON_KERNEL_DUMP",
        "TRITON_OVERRIDE_DIR",
        "LLVM_IR_ENABLE_DUMP",
    ):
        os.environ.pop(name, None)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(options.flagtree).resolve()))
    import triton
    from triton.backends.compiler import GPUTarget
    from triton.backends.nvidia import compiler as backend

    for name, record in job["runtime"]["compiler_files"].items():
        path = Path(importlib.import_module(name).__file__).resolve()
        if (
            path != Path(record["path"]).resolve()
            or trace.sha(path) != record["sha256"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Compiler identity changed: " + name)
    if (
        trace.sha(triton.__file__) != job["runtime"]["triton_init_sha256"]
        or trace.sha(os.environ["TRITON_PTXAS_PATH"])
        != job["runtime"]["ptxas"]["sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Runtime/assembler identity changed")
    if (
        trace.sha(job["ir"]) != job["ir_sha256"]
        or trace.sha(job["metadata"]) != job["metadata_sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Replay input changed")
    resume, code = resume_function(Path(backend.__file__).read_text(), vars(backend))
    (folder / "compiler-tail.txt").write_text(code)
    metadata = json.loads(Path(job["metadata"]).read_text())
    target = metadata["target"]
    if target != dict(backend="cuda", arch=90, warp_size=32):
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected target")
    before = trace.sha(backend.__file__)
    with patch.object(backend.CUDABackend, "make_ttgir", staticmethod(resume)):
        kernel = triton.compile(
            job["ir"],
            target=GPUTarget(**target),
            options=trace.restore_options(metadata),
        )
    if before != trace.sha(backend.__file__):
        raise RuntimeError("Installed compiler changed")
    for name in ("ptx", "ttgir"):
        (folder / (name + ".txt")).write_text(kernel.asm[name])
    (folder / "kernel.cubin").write_bytes(kernel.asm["cubin"])
    record = dict(
        status="compiled",
        gpu_kernel_executed=False,
        ptx_sha256=trace.sha(folder / "ptx.txt"),
        cubin_sha256=trace.sha(folder / "kernel.cubin"),
        shared_bytes=kernel.metadata.shared,
        schedule=inspect(kernel.asm["ttgir"], kernel.asm["ptx"]),
    )
    if job["kind"] == "control" and record["ptx_sha256"] != job["expected_ptx_sha256"]:
        record["status"] = "control_mismatch"
    trace.save(folder / "result.json", record)
    return 0 if record["status"] == "compiled" else 2


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-report", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--flagtree", default="/opt/flagtree")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=300)
    parser.add_argument("--worker-spec")
    options = parser.parse_args()
    if options.worker_spec:
        return child(options)
    report = Path(options.report_dir).resolve()
    report.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    summary = dict(
        status="preparing", gpu_kernel_executed=False, timings={}, jobs=[], decisions=[]
    )
    trace.save(
        report / "sources.json",
        {
            name: dict(text=(ROOT / name).read_text(), sha256=trace.sha(ROOT / name))
            for name in SOURCES
        },
    )
    try:
        if (
            trace.sha(ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py")
            != trace.PRODUCTION
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Production changed")
        jobs = prepare(Path(options.source_report).resolve(), report)
        for job in jobs:
            folder = Path(job["directory"])
            cmd = [
                sys.executable,
                "-I",
                str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                *sys.argv[1:],
                "--worker-spec",
                str(folder / "spec.json"),
            ]
            code = trace.run_job(
                cmd,
                dict(
                    os.environ,
                    PYTHONNOUSERSITE="1",
                    PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1",
                    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
                ),
                folder / "compiler.txt",
                options.timeout,
            )
            result = (
                json.loads((folder / "result.json").read_text())
                if (folder / "result.json").is_file()
                else {}
            )
            summary["jobs"].append(
                dict(name=job["name"], exit_code=code, result=result)
            )
            if code or result.get("status") != "compiled":
                print(
                    "\n".join((folder / "compiler.txt").read_text().splitlines()[-40:]),
                    flush=True,
                )
                raise RuntimeError("Compiler/control failed: " + job["name"])
            result.update(resources((folder / "compiler.txt").read_text()))
            trace.save(folder / "result.json", result)
            print(
                job["name"],
                "early K",
                result["schedule"]["early_K_copies"],
                "K slots",
                result["schedule"]["K_slots"],
                "registers",
                result["registers_per_thread"],
                "shared bytes",
                result["shared_bytes"],
                "spill store/load bytes",
                result["spill_store_bytes"],
                result["spill_load_bytes"],
                flush=True,
            )
            if job["kind"] == "producer":
                control = summary["jobs"][-2]["result"]
                reason = gate(control, result)
                decision = dict(
                    case=job["name"].rsplit("-", 1)[0],
                    status=(
                        "not_promising"
                        if reason
                        else "compile_feasible_pending_accuracy"
                    ),
                    reason=reason,
                    extra_K_slots=result["schedule"]["K_slots"]
                    - control["schedule"]["K_slots"],
                    extra_shared_bytes=result["shared_bytes"] - control["shared_bytes"],
                )
                summary["decisions"].append(decision)
                print("Decision:", decision, flush=True)
        summary["status"] = (
            "compile_feasible_pending_accuracy"
            if any(d["reason"] is None for d in summary["decisions"])
            else "not_promising"
        )
        print("No GPU execution. Score/TopK/pipeline timing: N/A.", flush=True)
        return 0
    except BaseException:
        summary.update(status="failed", error=traceback.format_exc())
        print(summary["error"], flush=True)
        return 1
    finally:
        trace.save(report / "producer-first-summary.json", summary)
        with tarfile.open(report / "producer-artifacts.tar.gz", "w:gz") as archive:
            for folder in sorted(report.iterdir()):
                if folder.is_dir() and folder.name.startswith("perf_"):
                    for path in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
                        if path.is_file():
                            archive.add(
                                path,
                                arcname=str(path.relative_to(report)),
                                recursive=False,
                            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
